completeCurrentEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Smite, Aura, and Lay on Hands are Oath mechanics and do not generate Weave Dissonance. After a successful melee hit, the next Oath spell before the end of the next turn generates 1 less Dissonance.
engine: Charisma governs Oath DC/M and divine technique attacks. Weapon attacks use their ordinary Strength/Dexterity ability. Hit Die d10; all armor, shields, simple and martial weapons. Paladin has no Conviction or Oracle Revelation Charges. Lay on Hands is its own pool, 5×Paladin level, fully restored only by long rest. Ordinary spells and printed Smite fuel use the same Paladin Core V 2 RP pool; healing points never convert to RP.

Base progression is explicit rather than the ordinary 25-card template: at 1 automatically gain Lay on Hands, Divine Sense, Martial Proficiency, Divine Strike, Protective Stance and Sacred Touch. At 2 gain Righteous Challenge, Bolstering Presence, Fighting Style and ordinary Paladin spell access. At 3 swear ONE of ten Oaths; gain only its Smite modification, Aura and first Revelation spell. This Oath is the Arch specialization. At 10 enter Hero Oath Mastery of that SAME Oath; no second Oath or additional generic Hero tree. Signature Power unlocks 11, Final Gift 20. Oath Revelations automatically unlock 3/5/9/13/17, always known in addition to the shared spell repertoire, rank 1/2/3/4/5 respectively. Exact printed RP costs replace generic cost only if the card explicitly supplies them.

At 2 choose one Fighting Style: Defense +1 AC while armored; Dueling +2 damage to first one-handed melee hit on your own turn; Protection Reaction impose disadvantage on one attack against an adjacent ally when using a shield. At 3 Divine Health gives advantage on disease saves, not universal immunity. At 5 Extra Attack makes two attacks when taking the ordinary Attack Action; named attack techniques use their own counts. These three features reconcile preserved main-registry entries; other old level-table extras, including extra level 14 ASI and undefined free slot riders, are not stacked into this draft. ASI/feat at 4/8/12/16/19 follows general advancement once.

Divine Strike at 1: after one melee weapon hit on your regular turn, spend 1 RP to add S d6 radiant. At 2 this becomes Divine Smite: choose 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for(S+1)d8 radiant, once/own turn total. Oath 3 changes type/rider as its card states, never adds another copy of the base damage. Smite is not an ordinary spell, cannot be counterspelled or generically Overcast, and causes no Dissonance. A critical hit doubles Smite damage dice under ordinary rules, but never healing, resources or percentage copies.

One Oath aura, requires consciousness and no concentration. Radius 10 ft at 3, 15 ft at 6, 20 ft at 10, 30 ft at 15. Benefits affect up to 3 allies or 3 enemies as the Oath card states, chosen at start of your turn and changed next turn; they must stay within aura. At 6 choose one additional aura benefit for that day: allies+1 saves against fear/charm, or 1 flat DR against weapon damage. At 7 once/short rest when enemy damages an ally in aura, Reaction make one melee attack if in reach; may pay normal Smite cost even off turn, but total Smite maximum one per round from this reactive feature. At 10 aura persists until start of your next regular turn after incapacitation; then ends if still incapacitated. At 15 also grant selected allies+1 initiative while in aura when initiative is rolled; no retroactive turn changes.

At 17 Aura Surge once/short rest Bonus Action: until start next turn choose up to 3 allies in aura to gain S+M temporary HP and+1 saves. This bounded surge replaces vague doubling of every aura number. At 20 Divine Manifestation makes the aura active upon initiative without an action, radius 30 ft; it ignores ordinary Silence and terrain obstruction between allies but not antimagic explicitly suppressing divine powers, planar barriers or the consciousness rule. Source cannot-be-suppressed language is bounded explicitly. It grants no free Signature, Smite or Revelation spell.

Protected interface: Smite, Aura and Lay on Hands generate no Weave Dissonance. After a successful direct melee hit, your next Oath spell before end next turn generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0, consuming the benefit. No stacking, RP discount or Refrain reset. Oath Revelation spells and the five replacement Forbidden spells below are ordinary spells for strain, countering and concentration; signature powers and final gifts are Oath techniques unless expressly tagged otherwise.

Oath conduct clauses remain intact in source and Oath cards. The Director identifies a relevant clause and a knowingly chosen serious breach before applying a fall. A disagreement, failed roll, coerced act or unknown fact does not silently remove a character. A fall is an explicit story transition recorded with the player: choose the corresponding Oathbreaker inversion or pursue an agreed restoration scene. Preserve class level and already spent resources. Oathbreaker replaces its Oath Aura, Smite rider, Signature and Revelation list, rather than stacking both sets. Base martial abilities remain; Lay on Hands becomes Death Touch using the same current 5 L pool, with no refill on switching.

Death Touch baseline: Action melee divine attack PB+CHA; declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points before the attack from remaining Lay on Hands pool to deal that much necrotic damage (choose amount before roll; miss still spends declared points). Each Oath inversion may alter type or add its bounded rider; never copy innate traits, confiscate class engines or automatically execute a target. A listed inverted Signature is available only at 11 and replaces the ordinary Signature use, one/short rest. An inverted aura follows the same radius, target cap and timing. Oathbreaker 20 uses the new Black Manifestation common capstone instead of its original Final Gift.

The source names a Forbidden Spell List but does not supply five complete entries for each inversion. This pilot explicitly adds one shared five-spell replacement list (below), with each Oathbreaker using its inversion name as flavor. These are new test rules, not recovered historical spells. Choose the normal Oath package OR inverted package at a time. All later Oath prerequisites still use Paladin class level; the Oathbreaker label does not bypass 3/11/20 gates.

Oath integration limits: one paid Smite total per round, including the level-7 Reaction; one Oath-aura reactive event per round. Multiple damage-redirection options share one event per round unless Crown Undying expressly allows two. Apply original-target defenses once, then split actual damage; transferred damage cannot be mitigated again, reflected, redirected again or generate resources. This explicit rule supersedes wording that permits recipient defenses again.

Sustained Oath spell damage/healing zones use concentration, at most three pulses, and 1 RP upkeep after the first pulse unless a priced card expressly supplies a different finite cadence. Native Oath auras retain their printed passive cadence and target cap. Final auras last their stated finite duration and include their pulses. All hard-denial effects, including compelled Actions, share the common once/source/target/encounter guard; later failures only remove Reactions and reduce Speed by half for one turn.

An emergency Reaction whose trigger itself incapacitates you, such as Grace Reversal or Thorn Crown, may resolve before that incapacitation only if you had a Reaction available before the triggering event. This grants no other actions while incapacitated. Narrative labels such as oppressor require a specific act of captivity/coercion established in the scene, not an alignment or identity assumption.

The source ceiling’s half-pool-per-round Lay on Hands cap is a preserved alternative. This pilot instead uses maximum class level per ordinary Lay on Hands Action and the explicitly once-per-long-rest level-17 Wave that distributes the current remaining pool. No normal heal gains the Wave’s exception.

For any one damage event choose exactly one Paladin redirection feature. Using it consumes the shared redirection allowance for that round. Crown Undying permits two DIFFERENT ally-damage events per round, but still only one redirection feature may modify each event.
workedExample: Paladin 5 Mercy, STR 16 CHA 16 PB 3 S 2 M 3: RP 6, Lay on Hands 25, two ordinary Attack Action attacks. Aura radius 10 ft until Paladin 6.
Turn 1 Attack Action: first hit permits 2 RP Smite, RP 6→4, adding 3d8 radiant. Second weapon hit receives no second Smite from this activation. Mercy healing uses only its printed bounded rider.
Turn 2 Action Lay on Hands spends 5 points to heal 5 HP, pool 25→20; it does not cost RP or add Dissonance. Bonus Action Protective Stance uses its own short-rest allowance; no free attack.
Turn 3 ordinary Attack Action hits. This primes the protected 1 D reduction for an Oath spell before end next turn; it does not refund 2 RP already spent or remove existing strain.

Turn 4 cast a rank 1 Oath Revelation for its printed 2 RP: RP 4→2 before strain surcharge, base 1 D becomes 0 from the primed hit. If immediately repeating the same spell, its Refrain still contributes after the single 1 D reduction.
At encounter end Lay on Hands remains 20 and RP 2. Short rest Retune restores RP by the shared formula up to 6, but never refills healing pool; long rest restores 25.
balanceQuestions: Is each Oath distinct at3 before its Signature at11?
Are Lay on Hands and RP meaningful separate budgets?
Does an Oathbreaker replacement preserve a playable character without stacking both packages?

cards.name: Lay on Hands
cards.cost: Choose 1 or more Lay on Hands points, maximum L per Action
cards.effect: Restore 1 HP per point spent, maximum class level per activation. Alternatively spend 5 points to end Poisoned or allow one immediate save against an existing disease that permits saves; cannot erase special-quest diseases, Wounds or death. This is finite pool healing, no RP conversion.

source.originalText: Lay on Hands: Healing pool equal to 5 × your Paladin level; can heal or remove conditions.

cards.name: Divine Sense
cards.effect: Know presence, number and direction of celestials, fiends and undead not behind total cover. Does not reveal identity, thoughts, moral alignment or ordinary hidden humanoids. At 18 reveals eligible disguised outsiders through mundane/magical disguises, still no total cover penetration.

source.originalText: Divine Sense: Detect the presence of celestial, fiendish, or undead entities within 60 feet.

cards.name: Martial Proficiency
cards.effect: Proficient with all simple/martial weapons, all armor and shields. Does not grant a second fighting style, extra attack, proficiency in every tool or double armor/shield bonuses.

source.originalText: Martial Proficiency: Proficiency with all armor types, shields, and weapons.

cards.name: Divine Strike
cards.effect: Use engine Divine Strike/Smite dice and later Oath modification. Declare after hit, then pay; normal critical dice rules. Not a spell and produces no Dissonance. Cannot trigger from reflected/copy/companion damage.

source.originalText: Divine Strike: Channel divine energy into your weapon attacks, dealing additional damage.

cards.name: Protective Stance
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once before end, Reaction interpose for adjacent ally hit by weapon: reduce its damage by S+M and take that much unpreventable damage yourself. Cannot redirect again or create resource/damage triggers. You must remain conscious.

source.originalText: Protective Stance: Enter a defensive posture that increases your AC and allows you to intercept attacks meant for nearby allies.

cards.name: Righteous Challenge
cards.effect: WIS save; failure disadvantage on attacks against other creatures while it can perceive you. It may move, use nonattack actions or decline attacks; no compelled suicide, belief change or full turn loss.

source.originalText: Righteous Challenge: Mark an enemy, forcing them to focus on you or suffer penalties.

cards.name: Bolstering Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies 15 ft who can perceive you
cards.effect: Each gains+2 on its next save against Charmed or Frightened and M temporary HP. Use strongest save bonus from same class; does not end existing conditions automatically.

source.originalText: Bolstering Presence: Inspire nearby allies, granting them temporary bonuses to saves against fear and charm effects.

cards.name: Sacred Touch
cards.effect: Stabilize a living Downed creature at 0 HP without healing; damage/ordinary rules can end stability. Alternatively pay 1 RP and examine 1 minute to learn whether one curse/disease affects it, without revealing origin or cure. No resurrection or free healing.

source.originalText: Sacred Touch: Channel divine energy to stabilize a dying creature or detect the presence of curses and diseases.

cards.name: Aura Scaling
cards.effect: Use exact radius, target cap, secondary benefit, reactive Smite, Aura Surge and Manifestation engine rules. Only chosen Oath aura applies; inverted aura replaces it. Multiple Paladin auras of same name do not stack numeric benefits.

source.originalText:
Aura Scaling
Level 3: 10 ft radius, base aura effect active while conscious
Level 6: 15 ft radius, gains secondary benefit (e.g., DR, saves)
Level 7: 15 ft radius, gain reactive Smite or spell trigger
Level 10: 20 ft radius, aura persists for 1 round if incapacitated
Level 15: 30 ft radius, aura debuffs enemies or buffs allies
Level 17: 30 ft radius, Aura Surge (1/rest) - double aura power or trigger burst effect
Level 20: 30+ ft radius, Divine Manifestation - aura auto-activates on initiative, cannot be suppressed

cards.name: Signature Power (Level 11)
cards.cost: One short-rest use plus printed cost
cards.effect: Automatically gain only your Oath's Signature, or corresponding inverted Signature if Oathbreaker. This unlock cannot be spent early as a Base/Arch selection. Rest references mean short rest unless card expressly long rest.

source.originalText:
Signature Power (Level 11)
Gain access to your Oath's Signature Power, a potent once-per-rest divine ability unique to your chosen Oath:

Mercy: Miracle Veil – Heal + Prevent death
Vengeance: Judgment Brand – Doom mark, bonus crit
Dominion: Heaven's Decree – Obey or suffer
Flame: Holy Inferno – AoE Smite purge
Ancients: Thorn Crown – Reflect status
Silence: Vow Unbroken – Bonus Smite if you stay silent
Chain: Warden's Lock – Lock enemies in zone
Grief: Final Vigil – Channel ally's power
Chains Broken: Righteous Quake – Break bindings, AoE push
Martyr King: Crown of Embers – Team-wide DR + damage redirection

cards.name: Divine Resistance (Level 13)
cards.effect: Choose fire, necrotic or psychic resistance. Same-type resistance does not stack. This is independent of Aura but does not automatically extend to allies.

source.originalText:
Divine Resistance (Level 13)
Choose one type of damage to gain resistance against: Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic.

cards.name: Lay on Hands
cards.cost: All remaining Lay on Hands points; minimum 1
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies in aura
cards.effect: Allocate remaining points among targets, at least 1 each; restore 1 HP per point. You may instead allocate 5 points per target to end Poisoned or Frightened. Spend entire pool, cannot multiply it by recipient count, raise the dead or remove Wounds. Oathbreakers instead deal allocated necrotic damage to 3 enemies, CON half, same pool cost.

source.originalText:
Lay on Hands: Full Cleansing Wave (Level 17)
Once per rest, expend your entire Lay on Hands pool to create a wave of healing energy that affects all allies within your aura radius.

cards.name: Divine Sense
cards.effect: Divine Sense identifies celestial/fiend/undead nature despite ordinary disguise or shapeshift. Still requires clear line of effect; cannot reveal through walls or defeat artifact-specific concealment without its rule.

source.originalText:
Divine Sense: Detect Disguised Outsiders (Level 18)
Your Divine Sense now reveals outsiders (celestials, fiends, etc.) even if they are disguised or shapeshifted.

cards.name: Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
cards.cost: One long-rest use plus printed cost
cards.effect: Gain only your Oath's Final Gift. Oathbreaker instead gains Black Manifestation below. Do not grant all ten gifts, restore use by switching Oaths, or combine with another Final from different class level.

source.originalText:
Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
Receive the ultimate blessing of your Oath, a powerful capstone ability that represents the pinnacle of your divine connection.

cards.name: Fighting Style
cards.activation: Passive or Reaction, according to choice
cards.effect: Choose Defense, Dueling or Protection using the exact engine profiles. Do not choose another style when entering the Oath or Hero stage.

cards.name: Divine Health
cards.effect: Advantage on saving throws against disease; no automatic immunity or cure of existing disease.

cards.name: Extra Attack
cards.effect: Make two weapon attacks instead of one. Named techniques use printed counts. This does not create two Smite triggers beyond their per-turn cap.

cards.name: Blighted Benediction
cards.effect: New rank 1 Forbidden spell. Divine spell attack; hit S d8 necrotic and target-1 on next attack roll. No healing, command or second strike. Ordinary spell strain applies.

cards.name: Dread Shelter
cards.effect: New rank 2 Forbidden spell. Gain 2 S+M temporary HP on casting and 1 flat DR against weapon damage for duration. No recurring temp HP pulse or healing.

cards.name: Profane Exchange
cards.effect: New rank 3 Forbidden spell. You must have more current HP than the unpreventable HP cost. Target CON save, 2 S d8 necrotic on failure, half success. HP loss cannot be reduced, redirected, refunded or used for another resource trigger.

cards.name: Desecrated Ground
cards.cost: 7 RP start; 1 RP per later pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius fixed point 30 ft, up to 3 enemies
cards.effect: New rank 4 Forbidden spell. Initial and each paid pulse CON save for S d6 necrotic, half success. A failed target receives 1 less HP per healing die until start of your next turn. Penalty cannot make healing negative or stack with another same-stat reduction.

cards.name: Last Reproach
cards.activation: Reaction after an enemy damages an ally
cards.rangeAndTarget: That enemy 60 ft; one living ally in your aura
cards.effect: New rank 5 Forbidden spell. Enemy WIS save for 3 S d8 necrotic, half success; ally regains S d8 HP after triggering damage. Does not revive dead or undo conditions. Uses ordinary spell strain and your Reaction.

cards.name: Black Manifestation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 enemies in aura
cards.effect: New Oathbreaker Final: gain 2 S+M temporary HP; chosen enemies WIS save or lose Reactions and Speed-10 ft for duration. Refresh one expended Signature use, then pay its normal Action and other costs when used. No Death Touch pool, RP, extra Action or Final reset.

cards.name: Merciful Smite
cards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack; up to 3 living allies within 10 feet of you
cards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
cards.effect: Your Oath Smite deals radiant damage instead of adding a second Smite packet. After the Smite damage resolves, create a healing pool equal to half the actual radiant Smite damage dealt, rounded down, maximum S+M. Divide that pool among up to 3 living allies within 10 feet. Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, remove Wounds or trigger additional Smite or healing-copy effects.

originalObjects.value: Radiant — bonus radiant damage; heals nearby allies for a portion dealt

conductClauses: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

cards.name: Aura of Mercy
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
cards.effect: The first time each round a selected ally receives HP healing from a finite or paid effect, add S HP. Each selected ally also reduces the first necrotic damage it takes each round by S. These benefits do not stack with another Aura of Mercy from the same source.

originalObjects.value: Aura of Mercy — allies gain increased healing received and resistance to necrotic damage

cards.name: Miracle Veil
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living ally in your Oath aura
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Trigger when the ally would be reduced below 1 HP by damage. Until the start of your next regular turn, that ally cannot be reduced below 1 HP by damage. The Veil does not prevent instant-death effects that explicitly bypass HP, does not resurrect a dead creature and removes no Wounds. Damage and attached conditions still resolve normally except for the HP floor.

originalObjects.value: Miracle Veil — protective barrier; ally cannot drop below 1 HP for the duration (1/rest)

cards.name: Blessing of the Meek
cards.duration: Healing instantaneous; AC bonus until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. If it was below half maximum HP before this healing, it also gains +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. This spell cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or generate additional healing triggers beyond ordinary once-per-effect rules.

value.spell: Blessing of the Meek — heal + AC if HP < 50%

cards.name: Ward of Shelter
cards.effect: For up to 3 rounds, each target reduces the first damage it takes each round by 2 and has advantage on saving throws against Frightened. Starting another concentration effect ends the Ward normally.

value.spell: Ward of Shelter — allies +2 DR, resist fear

cards.name: Channel Life
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and one living ally within 30 feet
cards.effect: Choose X from 1 to Paladin level+M, limited so your current HP remains at least 1. Lose X HP; this loss cannot be reduced, redirected or prevented. The target regains X HP. This is a direct transfer, cannot exceed the target's maximum HP and cannot remove Wounds or create excess temporary HP.

value.spell: Channel Life — transfer HP from self to ally

cards.name: Sanctify Ground
cards.cost: 7 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance after the first pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered within 30 feet; up to 3 allies per pulse
cards.effect: Resolve the first pulse on activation. On each of your next 2 regular turns you may pay 1 RP and a Bonus Action to produce another pulse. At each pulse choose up to 3 allies in the zone; each may end one of Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered, or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease or finite-duration curse that normally allows a save. A creature receives at most one cleansing choice per pulse.

value.spell: Sanctify Ground — zone removes conditions each round

oathCatalog.theme: Mercy is a shelter kept open in the worst hour: protection, healing, and the preservation of life before vengeance can make another wound.
conductClauses: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

oathCatalog.theme: Vengeance is judgment carried through the long road: fury disciplined into pursuit, execution held to a sworn account, and no refuge promised to the unrepentant.
conductClauses: Pursue sworn enemies until justice is served or they surrender; let no convenience excuse a broken charge
Do not abandon allies to feed a private vendetta, for judgment that leaves the faithful behind is only rage
Accept the surrender of those who genuinely repent, and hold them to the peace they have asked for

oathCatalog.theme: Authority held as a public burden: law spoken plainly, judgment bound to truth, and rulership measured by the safety it keeps
conductClauses: Uphold legitimate law and order, but do not call convenience or cruelty a lawful charge
Speak truth when acting as arbiter, and hear the whole matter before you command another
Do not use authority for personal gain; a decree that serves only its speaker has already failed the oath

oathCatalog.theme: A fire kept for cleansing rather than hunger: zeal tempered by restraint, corruption confronted, and renewal guarded after the ash
conductClauses: Purify corruption and undeath where found, but name the thing being purged before you raise the flame
Do not burn the innocent in zeal; fire that cannot distinguish harm from shelter has forsaken this oath
Accept that fire renews as well as destroys, and remain to protect what must grow after the burning

oathCatalog.theme: The living memory of the old places: nature guarded as a covenant, ancient power answered with humility, and renewal left possible for those who follow
conductClauses: Protect ancient places and living memory, especially where no living voice remains to speak for them
Do not destroy what cannot be restored; power does not excuse a wound made for haste
Honor pacts with fey and primal spirits, and do not mistake an old promise for permission to command

oathCatalog.theme: Humility, watchful restraint, and strength held in quiet
conductClauses: Speak when words serve the oath; let silence bear the rest
Do not claim glory for the work entrusted to you
Hear the whole matter before you judge it

oathCatalog.theme: A vigil of iron: martyrdom, warding, and the burden freely borne for another
conductClauses: Stand between the helpless and harm, even when the cost is yours to bear
Keep every ward entrusted to you; do not abandon the bound when danger closes
Take suffering freely to spare another, but never make a chain of their sacrifice

oathCatalog.theme: Sorrow, remembrance, and the duty of passage
conductClauses: Keep faith with the dead and with those they leave behind
Do not make sport of grief or profane a place of remembrance
Guide the departed toward rest; do not claim them for undeath

oathCatalog.theme: Liberty, the breaking of unjust bonds, and freedom guarded against a new tyranny
conductClauses: Break the bonds of the unjustly imprisoned, and do not turn liberation into license to abandon them
Resist every tyrant, including the one who would rule in freedom's name
Guard the newly freed from exploitation, for an open door is not yet a safe road

oathCatalog.theme: Stewardship, the burden of the crown, and sacrifice freely borne for those in your care
conductClauses: Bear the responsibility of command without treating those in your care as a means to your glory
Set the realm's need above personal gain, and spend your own strength before you spend another's
Never demand a burden you would not freely take upon yourself

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: A successful weapon hit between spell casts clears Refrain and reduces the next spell's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0), rewarding the Ranger's martial/primal cadence.
engine: Dexterity governs weapons; Wisdom governs primal technique DC/M. This draft uses the detailed book's d8 Hit Die; older runtime d10 remains preserved as a conflicting alternative. At 1 gain Track Target engine: Bonus Action mark one perceived enemy within 90 ft for 1 minute, no RP, one quarry at a time; new mark replaces old. Once/own turn a weapon hit against quarry adds S damage. Mark does not reveal creatures through total cover. Track Target selection is an upgrade, not a second unlock tax.

Weapon Synergy tracks last successful direct weapon hit on your own turns. Changing melee→ranged grants+1 to that ranged attack roll if it is your first attack of the turn; changing ranged→melee makes the hit apply Bleed 1d4 on target's next 2 turns. Once/turn synergy; Do Ts, copies, companions, forced attacks and misses do not advance it. At 5 ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks; techniques use only printed counts. You may draw/stow one weapon as normal object interaction; Dual Style later improves this.

Elemental Attunement is defensive; Elemental Imbue is the separate Pathfinder feature gated 6. Imbue Bonus Action 2 RP, one element for 3 of your turns; once/turn a weapon hit adds 1d4 of chosen element plus fire:Burn 1d4 next target turn, cold:Speed-10 ft until end next turn, poison:CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn. Nonstacking; Do Ts never build Hit Chain. Switching element pays again.

Druidic Arrow Combo starts at Ranger 11, not at Base 1. Each direct successful weapon hit adds 1 Hit Chain, maximum 2 gained per regular turn and cap 3. Completing 3 primes one Arrow until end next turn; using it consumes the chain, even on miss. Efficient Killer lowers threshold 2. Chain starts/ends encounters 0, cannot be stocked against allies/captives/summons and is cleared by incapacitation. The Arrow is one Action with a ranged weapon attack or the stated save, costs 0 RP when primed, and is a magical class technique rather than an ordinary spell cast. At most one Arrow per round; it cannot advance its own chain. It requires a wielded bow and ammunition. Ordinary attack/damage riders apply once as printed, never another free arrow.

All Rangers learn five bounded Arrows at 11. Emberroot requires the previous 3 successful weapon hits carried fire imbue: ranged attack, weapon+S d6 fire on hit; up to 2 others within 5 ft take S fire, and primary target Burns 1d4 next turn. Glacial Thorn requires 2 ranged+1 melee among those 3 hits: ranged attack weapon+S d6 cold; on hit STR save or Speed 0 until end next turn. Venomlash requires poisoned/blighted terrain at you or target: ranged attack weapon+S d6 poison; on hit CON save or-1 damage on its next attack. Spirit Fang requires quarry: ranged attack at advantage, weapon+S d6 force; ignores resistance but not immunity on the added force only. Cleansing Grove requires natural terrain at you or target: up to 3 living allies within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft each end Frightened or Poisoned; no attack or damage.

Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

A successful direct weapon hit between ordinary spell casts clears Refrain and gives the next ordinary spell before end next turn 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. The benefit is single-use/nonstacking; it reduces neither RP nor both base and repeat separately. Ordinary spells use Ranger rank gates and the shared test magic configuration.

Base choices 1–2, Pathfinder Arch 3–9, and chosen Warder/Stalker/Outrider Hero 10–20 are distinct stages. No source Arch capstone/Finale exists: level 9 receives its normal eligible choice, while 20 automatically improves your Hero Arrow once/long rest (new capstone below). Do not acquire a Hero by spending Base choices. Beast Companion is one permanent bond; it must be a willing/tamed noncorrupted beast with INT<7 and CR no greater than your class level. Its combat profile uses the bounded companion below rather than importing a full CR 20 monster.

If a primed Arrow expires unused, the prime ends and Hit Chain resets to 0. This applies equally to Efficient Killer’s threshold of two. Efficient Killer itself requires Ranger 11, when Hit Chain exists.
workedExample: Ranger 11, DEX 18, WIS 16, PB 4, S 3, M 3, RP 18. Track quarry with Bonus Action; no RP spent. Start Hit Chain 0.
Turn 1 normal Attack Action has 2 attacks; both hit quarry, chain 0→2. Apply quarry bonus 3 once, not twice. No Arrow until next qualifying hit.

Turn 2 first weapon attack hits, chain 2→3 and primes Arrow. You already spent your Action on Attack, so cannot freely add an Arrow. An extra Action from an ally would use the shared cap, but none is assumed.
Turn 3 use Spirit Fang Arrow as Action, consume chain 3→0, pay 0 RP. On hit weapon+3d6 force; advantage does not double damage. The Arrow cannot rebuild its own chain.

Turn 4 cast an ordinary rank 1 spell after the previous direct weapon hit between casts. Pay 2 RP, RP 18→16 plus any pre-existing strain surcharge. Its base 1 D is reduced by 1 to 0; the one-use cadence benefit ends.
On encounter end unused chain and mark expire. RP does not refill. Natural-terrain healing and companions still need their printed finite costs.
balanceQuestions: Can switching weapons remain worthwhile without eclipsing focused styles?
Does the level11 Arrow timing feel rewarding without free attacks?
Are permanent companions useful while respecting a shared command budget?

NEW NWQ-01 classification: this exact card is a magical nonspell class technique, not an ordinary spell, class spell, cantrip, Echo release or Matrix cast. Preserve spellRank:null and the historical originalText; no rank, school, spell component block, repertoire, spellcasting credential or class engine is inferred from its name, its historical minor-spell wording or its 1 RP cost.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

KEEP shared technique strain: pay 1 actual RP from your own existing lawful personal pool, not a donor pool or newly granted pool. No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. It does not clear, advance, consume or vent an ordinary spell-cadence record. Do not invent a casting ability or recompute a strain Limit for it. A later Perception or Survival check uses your own current applicable task ability and actual proficiency or replacing Expertise, ordinarily Wisdom, not a donor modifier or automatic borrowed skill proficiency. There is no activation attack or saving-throw DC. Its legal commitment is a magical-ability-use event: it prevents idle-turn Dissonance recovery on the actor's regular turn containing that commitment, including when the paid activation is interrupted. An illegal uncommitted declaration is not such an event. Merely retaining the rider or applying it to a later ordinary task is not another activation. Extra turns and off-turn releases create no additional recovery tick and cannot rewrite a completed tick. Actual separately acquired hooks operate only on their exact triggers; this is not a Bard Performance or an ordinary Ranger spell cast, and it grants no donor Track Target, Hit Chain, stabilization, Crescendo or Echo engine.

NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. A separately sourced interrupt or suppression must actually cover it; ordinary damage alone does not add a concentration requirement. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted. Reveal only real evidence supported by the actual successful task and observer rules; unknown data is not proof of absence. Failure does not reveal otherwise hidden facts. Expired, consumed or ended riders cannot be reclaimed by repeating a request.

KEEP generic nonspell Ready: this Action-time technique may be readied through the current Ready procedure. Ready setup spends its Action and records one perceivable trigger; it does not activate Nature's Whisper, pay its RP/feat use, start its Recharge, start its minute, update spell history or create held-spell concentration. On a legal release before Ready expires, spend the required permitted Reaction and perform the actual activation commitment instead of another Action; recheck its own entitlement, recharge, personal RP, terrain and, for borrowing, the prepared donor/signal conditions at that release. An invalid or declined trigger spends no release resource and may await another valid trigger within the same Ready window. Unreleased, replaced or expired Ready loses its setup Action but not an unspent Nature/feat cost. A legally released then interrupted activation retains all committed costs and Recharge. Native and borrowed copies use the actor's same source-ID recharge history; borrowing does not refresh it or the donor's history. Recharge 3 ticks once at each subsequent owner regular-turn start, or once per six elapsed seconds outside initiative without double counting; extra Actions and extra turns do not tick it. A recharge becoming ready grants no new borrowed feat use.

source.originalText: Nature's Whisper: Cast a minor nature spell that reveals hidden creatures or tracks within a small area.

cards.name: Skirmisher's Step
cards.effect: Move up to half Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Supplied movement does not increase remaining normal movement. Requires an unblocked route; no teleport or escape from restraints.

source.originalText: Skirmisher's Step: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

cards.name: Elemental Attunement
cards.effect: Choose fire/cold/poison. Gain resistance to that damage and sense an exposed source of it within 15 ft. Does not infuse weapons, detect through total cover or identify exact poison recipes.

source.originalText: Elemental Attunement: Temporarily attune yourself to an element (fire, cold, or poison), gaining minor resistance and the ability to detect that element.

cards.name: Ignore Difficult Terrain
cards.effect: Ignore movement cost increases from difficult terrain, including magical terrain. You still suffer its separate damage, restraints and hazards, and cannot cross impassable walls or surfaces without movement capability.

source.originalText: Ignore Difficult Terrain: Move normally through any type of difficult terrain.

cards.name: Enhanced Stealth and Perception
cards.effect: Gain+2 Stealth and Perception. It does not stack with Keen Senses on Perception; use+2 total from these class features. Advantage from another feature is separate.

source.originalText: Enhanced Stealth and Perception: Gain +2 to Stealth and Perception checks.

cards.name: Tactical Draw
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after switching melee/ranged weapon mode
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC after making an attack with the new mode. Drawing/stowing alone is insufficient. Further switches refresh neither extra AC nor actions.

source.originalText: Tactical Draw: Gain +1 AC after switching from bow to blade or vice versa.

cards.name: Vigilant Heart
cards.effect: You cannot be surprised by a creature you can perceive. Gain advantage on saves against scrying; on success learn someone attempted it but not identity/location. No blanket immunity to divination.

source.originalText: Vigilant Heart: Become immune to surprise and scrying attempts.

cards.name: Dual Style
cards.effect: Draw/stow a bow and up to 2 light melee weapons as one free exchange on your turn. This replaces normal object interaction for those weapons and cannot manipulate unrelated items or grant attacks.

source.originalText: Dual Style: Gain the ability to swap weapons as a free action (level 5).

cards.name: Elemental Imbue
cards.effect: Use the engine's fire/cold/poison Imbue: once/turn add 1d4 and its bounded elemental rider to a weapon hit. Switching element pays again. It does not stack multiple imbues or multiply Do Ts.

source.originalText: Elemental Imbue: Infuse your weapons with fire, cold, or poison to deal additional effects (level 6).

cards.name: Pathfinder's Mark
cards.rangeAndTarget: One fixed visible point within 30 ft
cards.effect: Know direction and rough distance to the point within 10 miles on same plane. A new mark replaces old. It does not create teleportation, observe occupants or reveal a path through barriers.

source.originalText: Pathfinder's Mark: Place a magical mark on a location that you can sense the direction and distance to for 24 hours.

cards.name: Natural Camouflage
cards.effect: Take Hide with advantage if foliage, rock or other natural cover can conceal you. Being stationary in open view does not qualify. Does not grant invisibility or hide your allies.

source.originalText: Natural Camouflage: Blend into natural surroundings, gaining advantage on Stealth checks while stationary.

cards.name: Terrain Analysis
cards.effect: Learn up to 2 observable tactical facts: difficult ground, unstable footing, tracks or usable cover. Director states facts supported by senses; hidden magical traps still need normal checks. Next ally following your identified safe route gains+5 ft movement once.

source.originalText: Terrain Analysis: Quickly survey an area to gain tactical information about the environment.

cards.name: Swift Traverse
cards.effect: Take Dash, gaining movement equal to Speed; ignore opportunity attacks from your quarry during this movement only. No free attacks, flight, wall traversal or doubled daily travel rate.

source.originalText: Swift Traverse: Move at double speed for a short time when in natural terrain.

cards.name: Predator's Mark
cards.effect: Upgrade current mark: first direct weapon hit per turn adds 1d6 rather than the engine's flat S; choose the higher, not both. Know quarry direction while within 90 ft unless blocked by total cover. Requires concentration; ordinary mark remains if this upgrade ends.

source.originalText: Predator's Mark: Mark a tracked target for bonus damage and enhanced awareness of their movements (level 9).

cards.name: Living Pulse
cards.effect: You may pay 1 RP to regain 2 HP. Does not trigger when Downed or incapacitated, cannot exceed maximum and never counts as another healing spell. Replaces unlimited passive regeneration with a finite cost.

source.originalText: Living Pulse: Regenerate 2 HP per round while in natural terrain.

cards.name: Beast Empathy
cards.rangeAndTarget: Natural beasts within 30 ft that hear you
cards.effect: Communicate simple emotions/directions. They are not automatically friendly or controlled, cannot answer beyond their experience, and may need normal Animal Handling. No language-based compulsion or extra companion slot.

source.originalText: Beast Empathy: Communicate basic concepts with natural beasts.

cards.name: Warden's Vigilance
cards.effect: Learn direction of one substantial recent fire, poisoning or unnatural blight in the area. Does not locate arbitrary enemies or identify culprits. A protected or planar-hidden effect may remain undetected.

source.originalText: Warden's Vigilance: Detect threats to natural areas within a large radius.

cards.name: Healing Touch
cards.rangeAndTarget: One other ally healed by your paid spell/item
cards.effect: Add M HP to actual healing. Do not multiply potion dice or duplicate consumed items; cannot apply to regeneration, companions' healing, copies or another Ranger's same bonus.

source.originalText: Healing Touch: Your healing spells and items are 25% more effective on allies.

cards.name: Rootcall Quake
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
cards.effect: STR save or Speed 0. Each affected target repeats save at end of each turn and may use Action to attempt escape using STR(Athletics) against class DC. Flying creatures not touching ground are unaffected.

source.originalText: Rootcall Quake: Create an area effect that roots enemies in place.

cards.name: Healing Briar
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft-radius natural-ground zone within 30 ft; 3 allies/pulse
cards.effect: On start heal 1d8+M per chosen living ally; on next 2 turns Bonus Action+1 RP repeats pulse. Maximum 3 pulses; no passive additional entry healing and no Wound removal.

source.originalText: Healing Briar: Establish a healing zone that restores health to allies within it.

cards.name: Warden's Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: Empty space adjacent to injured ally within 30 ft
cards.duration: Instant; pressure until start next turn
cards.effect: Teleport to visible legal space. Up to 2 adjacent enemies make WIS save; failure gives disadvantage on next attack against someone other than you. No forced targeting, movement or whole-Action loss.

source.originalText: Warden's Step: Teleport to an injured ally and taunt nearby foes.

cards.name: Nature's Blessing
cards.effect: Ally gains+10 ft Speed and S d6+M temporary HP on start. While effect lasts it has advantage on saves against forced movement. Temporary HP are not refreshed each turn.

source.originalText: Nature's Blessing: Grant an ally temporary bonuses to speed and resilience.

cards.name: Beast Companion
cards.cost: 4 RP; 1 hour with a willing/tamed eligible beast
cards.effect: Bond eligible beast using standard companion stats plus Wisdom modifier HP; preserve one movement mode up to 40 ft and keen-sense advantage. Bonus Action command gives one attack, no imported boss powers. Injury persists; heal normally. Death requires a new bond after long rest, not free resummoning.

source.originalText: Beast Companion: Tame one beast from the bestiary (CR ≤ your level, INT < 7, not corrupted) as a permanent companion that scales with your Wisdom and level.

cards.name: Hunter's Reflex
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC against the next ranged attack targeting you. Benefit ends after that attack, hit or miss. Multiple shots do not create multiple dodge charges.

source.originalText: Hunter's Reflex: Gain +10% Dodge chance after making a ranged attack.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.effect: Leave no mundane footprints and make no ordinary footstep sound. You still need cover and Stealth to hide; speech, equipment noise, scent, tremorsense and magical tracking remain possible.

source.originalText: Shadow Step: Leave no tracks and make no sound when moving at normal speed.

cards.name: Keen Hunter
cards.effect: If quarry attempts to Hide while visible to you, you know its position until it gains total cover or leaves your sight. Does not negate invisibility, darkness or planar travel without an appropriate sense.

source.originalText: Keen Hunter: Tracked targets cannot hide from you within your line of sight.

cards.name: Efficient Killer
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your Hit Chain after class 11 unlock
cards.effect: Arrow threshold becomes 2 successful direct weapon hits instead of 3; gain cap remains 2/turn. The source of an Arrow's combo prerequisite still needs its stated history; Emberroot/Glacial may require 3 hits even though chain is primed at 2.

source.originalText: Efficient Killer: Reduce the Hit Chain requirement for Druidic Arrow to 2 hits instead of 3.

cards.name: Camouflage Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self in natural cover or dim light
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack/cast
cards.effect: Become invisible; ends immediately after your first attack roll or spell cast, hit or miss. No automatic surprise. Taking damage does not itself end it, but ordinary senses can locate you.

source.originalText: Camouflage Step: Become invisible until you make your first attack.

cards.name: Silent Volley
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 distinct enemies in bow range
cards.effect: Make 3 bow attacks, each weapon die without ability damage modifier. Ignore half cover, not armor or total cover. Quarry/riders once per their limits; chain gains at most 2. This is not three full Attack Actions.

source.originalText: Silent Volley: Fire three arrows in rapid succession, ignoring armor bonuses.

cards.name: Shattershot
cards.duration: Instant; shield suppression until end next turn
cards.effect: One bow attack; hit adds S d6 piercing. Target makes STR save or loses its shield's AC bonus until end next turn. One visible rank 1–3 magical defense can instead be suppressed after a WIS save failure; never permanently destroys gear or dispels everything.

source.originalText: Shattershot: Fire a specialized arrow that breaks shields and removes magical buffs.

cards.name: Ghost Strike
cards.effect: One melee weapon attack with+2 to hit; on hit add S d6 force. Only added force ignores resistance, not immunity. Does not remove natural armor, all AC or legendary defenses.

source.originalText: Ghost Strike: Make a melee attack that bypasses physical armor.

cards.name: Vanishing Act
cards.duration: Until start next turn or attack/cast
cards.effect: Teleport to unoccupied visible space and become invisible until the stated end. Cannot pass a ward that blocks teleportation, escape a dimensional prison or retain invisibility after attacking.

source.originalText: Vanishing Act: Disappear from sight and reposition to any point within 30 feet.

cards.name: Predator's Grin
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after directly reducing quarry to 0
cards.effect: Gain one extra full Action next turn within the shared cap. It cannot grant another Action or trigger another Predator's Grin. Allies, summons, helpless creatures and ongoing copied damage do not qualify.

source.originalText: Predator's Grin: Killing a tracked target grants you an extra action once per rest.

cards.name: Toxic Affinity
cards.effect: Immune to Poisoned and nonmagical disease; gain poison resistance. This deliberately replaces blanket immunity to every poison/disease source. Existing magical diseases require their own treatment.

source.originalText: Toxic Affinity: Gain immunity to poison and disease.

cards.name: Corruption Touch
cards.effect: Imbue lasts 6 turns instead of 3. On a weapon critical, one other enemy within 5 ft takes 1d4 of imbue type. No additional condition, Hit Chain or recursive critical effects on that secondary damage.

source.originalText: Corruption Touch: Your elemental imbues last twice as long and spread to adjacent targets on critical hits.

cards.name: Blight Infusion
cards.rangeAndTarget: Primary target of your Arrow on blighted ground
cards.effect: On hit target makes CON save or the next HP healing it receives is reduced by M, minimum 0. This is temporary Blight, not permanent campaign Corruption; multiple applications do not stack.

source.originalText: Blight Infusion: Your Druidic Arrows inflict Blight on hit if the terrain is corrupted.

cards.name: Venom Rain
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in 10 ft-radius area within 60 ft
cards.duration: Instant; Poisoned until end next turn
cards.effect: CON save: S d8 poison, half on success; failure Poisoned until end next turn. No permanent Corruption gain, contagious disease or poison harvesting. This is a paid technique and does not build Hit Chain.

source.originalText: Venom Rain: Create an area effect that deals poison damage and applies Corruption.

cards.name: Rotting Tether
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy standing on ground within 60 ft
cards.effect: CON save or tethered: first time it voluntarily moves at least 5 ft each turn, takes S d4 necrotic. Repeat save at turn end ends tether. Forced movement causes no damage; maximum 1 tick/turn, no whole-turn loss.

source.originalText: Rotting Tether: Link an enemy to corrupted terrain, causing damage when they move.

cards.name: Entropic March
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 15 ft-radius ground area within 60 ft
cards.effect: Create temporary blighted difficult terrain. On start and first entry/start of turn, up to 3 enemies take S d4 necrotic, CON half, maximum once/creature/round. Ground returns unchanged afterward; no permanent ecological corruption or resource farming.

source.originalText: Entropic March: Convert natural terrain into Blighted terrain in a large area.

cards.name: Withering Shot
cards.duration: Instant; until end target's next turn
cards.effect: Bow attack; hit adds S d6 necrotic and target makes CON save. Failure halves the next HP healing it receives before expiry, rounding down. No stacking with another reduction to create negative healing.

source.originalText: Withering Shot: Fire an arrow that drastically reduces the target's healing received.

cards.name: Plague Bearer
cards.effect: Your first weapon hit each turn adds 1d6 poison; target CON save or Poisoned until end next turn. You lose M real HP on activation, cannot fall below 1. The controlled effect is not a transmissible permanent disease and creates no free toxins.

source.originalText: Plague Bearer: Infect yourself with a controlled disease that spreads to enemies you damage.

cards.name: Master of the Hunt — new Hero capstone
cards.effect: New playtest Hero capstone. Once per long rest when using your Hero Arrow, pay its normal Hit Chain/action requirements, then enhance only that activation: Warder grants 2 M temporary HP instead of M; Stalker adds S d6 piercing to one of its two hits; Outrider adds S d4 necrotic to one target on its single pulse. No extra Arrow, Hit Chain, action or copied proc.

completeCurrentEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per round, the first spell cast inside the Shaman's own active Totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance (minimum 0).
engine: Wisdom is the class ability. Choose Elemental Affinity automatically at 1: Fire, Ice, Air or Earth. Spellcasting/RP remain separate from Totem objects and flasks. Totem capacity 1, rises 2 at 13; any third replaces one of your existing totems. A totem is a visible Tiny magical object: AC 12+PB, HP 2 L, immobile, immune to poison/psychic/conditions, vulnerable to ordinary weapon and other damage. At 0 HP its aura ends. A new totem appears within 30 ft; cannot occupy a creature's space, serve as a bridge, trap a creature without a save or move through walls.

Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

On your turn you may spend Bonus Action to move one totem up to 15 ft along unobstructed ground, remaining within 60 ft. This competes with healing maintenance, companion commands and advanced flasks. Moving an aura over a creature cannot trigger its once/round effect repeatedly. Totem destruction creates no resource return. Once per round, the first ordinary spell cast while inside your own active totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0; no RP reduction.

The book places Flask Use at Base but describes advanced flask casting as Theurgist/Soothsayer-only. For this draft, Base Flask Use grants mundane prepared tactical flasks thrown with an Action; at Hero 10 only Theurgist/Soothsayer gain magical Bonus Action flasks. Bloodcaller retains mundane alchemical knowledge, not the advanced flask subsystem. At long rest prepare 2 flasks, rising to 3 at 5 and 4 at 11; no encounter refill or stockpiling, total carry cap 4, unused contents become inert when preparing a new batch. This finite-rest supply replaces encounter-based free heal farming.

Flask tier uses S. Mundane Base modes: Burn=one enemy 30 ft DEX save S d6 fire half, failure 1d4 fire next turn; Root=one ground enemy 30 ft STR save Speed 0 until end its next turn; Weaken=one enemy 30 ft CON save or-1 attack damage until end its next turn. Advanced Hero modes additionally: Stun=one enemy 30 ft CON save or no Reactions, failure by 10 Stunned until end its next turn; Heal=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Restore=end Frightened or Poisoned on one ally 30 ft. Every thrown flask consumes one prepared unit and 2 RP for advanced magic (Base mundane flasks cost 0 RP). Changing payload requires no separate crafting action when throwing. No flask leaves harvestable poison or another flask.

Choose Fire/Ice/Air/Earth bonuses through affinity card; Ember/Cold/Shock damage are fire/cold/lightning, Earth uses bludgeoning. Summoned elemental spirits use one standard companion each, maximum one normally; Elemental Chorus expressly summons a package of 4 but all share one Bonus Action command and a printed combined pulse. Companions cannot generate RP, trigger flask refunds or create corpse/kill farms.

Bloodcaller at Hero 10 transforms permanently into Hagraven, with the player choosing this class path and its stated loss of ordinary Shaman spellcasting. It does NOT lose its RP reservoir: printed Hagraven/Totem techniques still pay RP, but it cannot cast ordinary Shaman spells or advanced magical flasks. It retains prior totem/technique selections. The change is a class choice, not permission for involuntary player-character conversion; ancestry identity and player control remain. At long rest it can prepare mundane flasks only if Base Flask Use is known.

Shaman Base 1–2, Spiritwalker Arch 3–9, and Theurgist/Soothsayer/Bloodcaller Hero 10–20 remain separate stages. Elemental Affinity is automatic 1, not an extra selection cost. No explicit Arch capstone in source:9 has its ordinary choice. At 20 your selected Hero's last active ultimate gains the explicit new capstone improvement below; no new generic Hero class is invented.
workedExample: Shaman 5, WIS 16, PB 3, S 2, M 3, RP 12. Know Totem Casting, Spirit Shock, Flask Use, Elemental Ward at 1. Prepare 3 mundane flasks after a real long rest. Totem capacity 1.
Turn 1: Action Totem Casting places Renewal within 30 ft, pays 2 RP (12→10). Up to 3 allies inside regain 2 HP each. One concentration effect is active.
Turn 2: Bonus Action maintenance pays 1 RP (10→9), heals 2 HP to up to 3 allies. Action Spirit Shock costs 2 RP (9→7) and deals 2d8 on failed save. No extra flask Bonus Action remains.
Turn 3: Bonus Action+1 RP Renewal maintenance (7→6), final 2 HP pulse. Action throws one mundane Root flask, prepared count 3→2, no RP; target STR save. Its save success gives no refund.
At start turn 4 totem expires. Placing a new Renewal costs full 2 RP and starts another finite 3 pulse effect. Encounter end does not refill flasks or RP.
At Hero 10 a Bloodcaller still uses this totem/technique loop, but cannot cast ordinary Shaman spells or advanced Bonus Action magical flasks.
balanceQuestions: Do totem movement and maintenance create useful Bonus Action choices?
Do flask preparation limits stop healing stockpiles without making alchemy tedious?
Does Hagraven retain enough breadth after losing ordinary spellcasting?

cards.name: Elemental Affinity
cards.effect: Choose Fire: first fire technique hit/turn adds 1 damage; Ice: first cold damage target/turn loses 5 ft Speed until end next turn; Air:+5 ft Speed; Earth:+1 on STR/CON saves against forced movement. These are alternatives, not cumulative affinities.

source.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Choose an element (Fire, Ice, Air, or Earth) that enhances your abilities.

cards.name: Spirit Sight
cards.effect: Perceive location/outline of invisible spirits and elementals not behind total cover. This does not reveal unrelated invisible creatures, private memories or all magical traps. No attack advantage against ordinary hidden creatures.

source.originalText: Spirit Sight: Perceive spirits and elemental forces invisible to others.

cards.name: Alchemical Knowledge
cards.effect: Gain advantage on INT(Arcana) or alchemist-tool checks to identify a substance's mundane ingredients and likely purpose. Identification does not guarantee safety or supply a recipe/materials; failure yields uncertainty, not false certainty.

source.originalText: Alchemical Knowledge: Identify potions and alchemical substances with greater accuracy.

cards.name: Primal Resilience
cards.effect: Resistance to affinity damage: Fire fire, Ice cold, Air lightning, Earth thunder. Does not stack with another resistance or grant immunity to related terrain hazards.

source.originalText: Primal Resilience: Gain resistance to your chosen elemental affinity.

cards.name: Ancestral Whispers
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self just failing a Perception or initiative-related check
cards.effect: Reroll with+M, using the new result. Requires ability to hear the spirit warning; cannot reroll a save/attack or retroactively undo a completed ambush round.

source.originalText: Ancestral Whispers: Occasionally receive guidance from ancestral spirits when in danger.

cards.name: Flask Use
cards.effect: Throw a Burn, Root or Weaken flask using the exact engine profile. At Hero 10 Theurgist/Soothsayer may instead throw an advanced mode as Bonus Action for 2 RP and a prepared flask. Bloodcaller does not gain that upgrade.

source.originalText: Flask Use: Create and throw elemental bombs (2 per encounter) that cause various effects.

cards.name: Totem Casting
cards.rangeAndTarget: One totem within 30 ft with 15 ft aura
cards.effect: Place one Flame/Stone/Frost/Spirit/Renewal totem using the engine's exact profile. All your totems share concentration. Respect 3 creature aura/pulse limit; same-stat bonuses do not stack. Replacing a totem ends it without refund.

source.originalText: Totem Casting: Place a totem that creates an aura effect for 3 rounds.

cards.name: Spirit Shock
cards.effect: Target makes DEX save: S d8 affinity damage, half on success. Affinity rider applies once; this printed technique is not an ordinary spell, cannot Overcast and does not generate a flask or totem.

source.originalText: Spirit Shock: Channel elemental energy into a damaging burst.

cards.name: Commune with Spirits
cards.rangeAndTarget: Local spirit within 30 ft or area examined
cards.effect: Ask about events the local spirit could have perceived within the previous day. Director gives truthful sensory information or unknown. No compelled omniscience, future certainty or forced player beliefs.

source.originalText: Commune with Spirits: Gain information about an area or object by consulting with local spirits.

cards.name: Elemental Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self or ally within 15 ft taking elemental damage
cards.effect: Reduce acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder damage by S d6+M, minimum 0. No reflected damage or resource gain. Does not protect from unrelated physical/psychic damage.

source.originalText: Elemental Ward: Create a temporary barrier against a specific type of elemental damage.

cards.name: Enhanced Elemental Attunement
cards.effect: Fire adds 1 to first fire damage roll; Ice's slow increases to 10 ft; Air also gives+1 initiative; Earth adds+1 to CON concentration saves. These replace corresponding basic affinity quantities rather than duplicating them.

source.originalText: Enhanced Elemental Attunement: Your chosen element grants additional benefits to your abilities.

cards.name: Extended Totem Duration
cards.cost: 0; full upkeep for extra Renewal pulse
cards.effect: Totems last 1 extra turn. Renewal may have a fourth pulse only if you pay Bonus Action+1 RP on that turn; no fifth pulse and no automatic free healing. Concentration still required.

source.originalText: Extended Totem Duration: Totems last for an additional round.

cards.name: Spirit Cache
cards.rangeAndTarget: One flask/to-tem effect you directly used
cards.effect: Store its profile, not an active copy. On a later turn use normal Action/Bonus Action and pay all RP and a new flask unit or full totem cost to repeat it. Add 1d6 to one numerical damage/heal amount; no copy of refund/limited use.

source.originalText: Spirit Cache: Store one flask or totem effect to recast later (once per encounter).

cards.name: Totem Pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures inside newly placed non-healing totem
cards.effect: On placement pay 1 RP: allies gain M temporary HP OR enemies make DEX save for S affinity damage, half on success. No immediate second Renewal healing pulse, no repeat from moving the totem.

source.originalText: Totem Pulse: Totems create an immediate area effect when placed (level 6).

cards.name: Spirit Saturation
cards.effect: Waive its 2 RP placement cost once. Still use Action, concentration, capacity and any added costs. Cannot create a healing totem or be cached/refunded to generate more free casts.

source.originalText: Spirit Saturation: Gain one free totem cast per combat (level 9).

cards.name: Elemental Channeling
cards.effect: Embody affinity: gain+10 ft Speed and once/turn add 1d4 affinity damage to a weapon hit. Fire/cold/lightning/bludgeoning by affinity. This concentration replaces your totem burden, so it is a tactical alternative.

source.originalText: Elemental Channeling: Temporarily embody your chosen element, gaining related benefits.

cards.name: Spirit Walk
cards.effect: Move up to 15 ft through creatures and nonmagical material no thicker than 5 ft, ending in a visible empty space. Gain no attack immunity; take 1d6 force if no legal exit and return to starting space. No attacks/casts while inside matter.

source.originalText: Spirit Walk: Briefly become incorporeal, passing through solid objects or avoiding damage.

cards.name: Ancestral Guardian
cards.effect: A guardian prevents S d8+M damage, minimum 0. It then vanishes and creates no companion action, corpse or refund. Cannot prevent sacrifice/trauma or redirect prevented damage into another trigger.

source.originalText: Ancestral Guardian: Summon a protective spirit that intercepts damage meant for you.

cards.name: Elemental Surge
cards.effect: Choose one: aura radius+5 ft OR numerical flat benefit improves by 1. Renewal instead adds M HP to its next paid pulse, once, without adding a pulse. Same-name/stat stacking rules remain.

source.originalText: Elemental Surge: Enhance a totem's effect for one round.

cards.name: Spirit Binding
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally or held object within 30 ft
cards.effect: Ally gains resistance to your affinity damage; OR its held weapon adds 1d4 affinity damage on first hit/turn. Choose one, fixed for duration. Spirit cannot cast independently or grant spell knowledge.

source.originalText: Spirit Binding: Temporarily bind a minor elemental spirit to an object or ally, granting benefits.

cards.name: Echo Totem
cards.rangeAndTarget: Adjacent empty space within 5 ft of newly placed totem
cards.effect: Create a weak echo anchor of that totem. It counts toward capacity; if no space in capacity, cannot create it. Its radius 10 ft and numerical bonuses/healing are half, rounded down. Shared concentration/upkeep and same-name nonstacking prevent double healing.

source.originalText: Echo Totem: Automatically cast a second, weaker totem when placing your primary totem.

cards.name: Elemental Harmony
cards.effect: Add class level to its maximum/current HP on creation and 1 turn duration, maximum 4 turns for class summons. Cannot extend once/day Chorus beyond 4 turns or restore an existing creature's lost HP.

source.originalText: Elemental Harmony: Your elemental summons gain increased duration and health.

cards.name: Spiritual Resonance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Two of your active totems within 10 ft of one another
cards.effect: Their aura radii increase 5 ft. No extra targets or extra pulses and overlapping same-name benefits do not stack. One totem and its echo still use normal capacity.

source.originalText: Spiritual Resonance: Totems affect a larger area when placed near each other.

cards.name: Benevolent Spirits
cards.rangeAndTarget: One ally below half HP healed by your paid technique
cards.effect: Add M HP to that healing. It does not improve multiple targets, copies or triggered heals, and cannot itself trigger Benevolent Spirits again.

source.originalText: Benevolent Spirits: Your healing effects are 25% more powerful on allies below half health.

cards.name: Summon Ice Wisp
cards.rangeAndTarget: One spirit in empty space within 30 ft
cards.effect: Summon standard Ice Wisp with fly 30 ft. Commanded attack deals cold; on hit target STR save or Speed 0 until end its next turn. No whole-turn freezing, bonus independent spells or multiple companion attacks.

source.originalText: Summon Ice Wisp: Call forth a spirit of frost that can snare and freeze enemies.

cards.name: Summon Airling
cards.effect: Summon standard Airling with fly 40 ft. Commanded attack deals lightning; on hit target CON save or loses Reactions until end its next turn. Failure by 10 also Stunned, subject to the shared hard-denial guard across all the Shaman’s features. Companion Stun counts as the Shaman’s denial; if the target already suffered that denial this encounter, only damage and Reaction loss resolve. One shared companion command.

source.originalText: Summon Airling: Conjure an air elemental that stuns enemies and deals lightning damage.

cards.name: Summon Cinderflame
cards.effect: Summon standard Cinderflame. Commanded hit deals fire plus Burn 1d4 next target turn. On destruction only (not dismissal), up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX save for S d4 fire, half. Explosion creates no further death/resource triggers.

source.originalText: Summon Cinderflame: Create a fire spirit that applies burning damage over time and explodes on death.

cards.name: Summon Stonekin
cards.effect: Summon standard Stonekin. Command chooses bludgeoning attack with STR save or Prone on hit, OR gives up to 3 adjacent allies reduction 2 until start next turn. No simultaneous attack and protection command.

source.originalText: Summon Stonekin: Manifest an earth elemental that can root enemies and grant damage reduction to allies.

cards.name: Elemental Chorus
cards.rangeAndTarget: Four spirits in 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft
cards.effect: Summon a single Chorus package: four visible spirits share HP 4 L, AC 12+PB, immobile. Bonus Action command pulses up to 3 enemies: DEX save S d6 chosen affinity damage half; one failed target Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Four spirits do not make four separate attacks.

source.originalText: Elemental Chorus: Ultimate ability that summons all four elemental types around a zone for massive combined effect.

cards.name: Divining Totem
cards.rangeAndTarget: One divining totem within 30 ft; observed enemy in aura
cards.effect: Each own-turn start choose one visible enemy in 15 ft aura. First ally attack against it before your next turn gains+1 to hit; first attack it makes has-1. Predicts immediate intent, not guaranteed future actions; totem has ordinary object stats.

source.originalText: Divining Totem: Place a special totem that reveals enemy actions before they occur (one target per round).

cards.name: Predictive Alchemy
cards.effect: Retain the spent flask count once, but still pay RP/Action and all other costs. This deterministic refund cannot be copied, cached or apply to another refunded use. Carry cap 4 remains.

source.originalText: Predictive Alchemy: Your flasks have a chance to not be consumed when used.

cards.name: Fate's Whisper
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self before making a saving throw
cards.effect: Gain advantage on that save. Must declare before rolling; no additional reroll if advantage already applies. Does not create a Prophecy Trigger or restore RP.

source.originalText: Fate's Whisper: Gain advantage on one saving throw per encounter.

cards.name: Balanced Elements
cards.effect: Choose one application: add 1 damage to its next Burn tick OR extend a Speed reduction until end target's following turn. Never extends Stunned, silence, concentration duration or whole-Action denial.

source.originalText: Balanced Elements: Your elemental effects last longer and have secondary effects.

cards.name: Delayed Detonation
cards.effect: Set a flask to trigger at start next turn or first enemy entering 5 ft before then; choose when placing. On trigger one creature within 5 ft resolves its normal payload/save. If no target when timer ends it is spent harmlessly. No repeated explosions.

source.originalText: Delayed Detonation: Throw a flask that explodes after a set time or trigger.

cards.name: Healing Splash
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies in 5 ft radius within 30 ft
cards.effect: Each regains S d6+M HP, shared roll. This consumes a flask and replaces its normal payload. No damage to enemies, free conditions removed or resource refunds beyond the explicit once/day Predictive Alchemy.

source.originalText: Healing Splash: Convert a damage flask into an area healing effect.

cards.name: Omen Brand
cards.effect: Next ally attack against target has advantage and ignores half cover; not an automatic hit. If attack misses the brand ends. Cannot override total cover, immunity or target legality.

source.originalText: Omen Brand: Mark a target so that the next ally's ability against them automatically hits.

cards.name: Fate Weaving
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 60 ft just rolled an attack/save/check
cards.effect: Force one d20 reroll after result known but before consequence, using new result. Cannot reroll damage, resource quantities, a reroll or an already resolved event. No beliefs or future outcomes guaranteed.

source.originalText: Fate Weaving: Manipulate probability to force a reroll of any die.

cards.name: Omen Loop
cards.cost: Normal RP+2 RP; fresh flask if required; 1 long-rest use
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your own qualifying effect used within previous 2 turns
cards.effect: Repeat one non-Finale, non-resource-restoring class flask/totem effect with normal targets and full costs. It replaces the current Action; cannot repeat another repeat, regain per-rest uses or exceed totem capacity. If effect required a flask, consume one now.

source.originalText: Omen Loop: Ultimate ability that repeats a spell, flask, or totem cast from two turns ago (once per encounter).

cards.name: Hagraven Form
cards.effect: Become Hagraven: retain player control/mental stats, light-armor use and ordinary movement; claws are finesse 1d6 slashing, darkvision 60 ft and poison resistance. Lose ordinary Shaman spellcasting/advanced magical flasks; retain RP for printed techniques and totems. No free flight or hidden monster stat block.

source.originalText: Hagraven Form: Your body transforms into a twisted, avian-humanoid hybrid with natural weapons and resistances.

cards.name: Blood Feast
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self at start regular turn; hostile bleeding creature within 10 ft
cards.effect: Pay 1 RP to regain M HP. Bleeding allies, summons or staged captives cannot qualify. No healing while Downed; secondary heal creates no damage/resource triggers.

source.originalText: Blood Feast: Heal when enemies near you are bleeding.

cards.name: Necrotic Aura
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 10 ft at your turn start
cards.effect: Pay 1 RP; CON save S d4 necrotic, half on success. This replaces unlimited free aura damage. Cannot trigger itself, create Bleed or generate additional RP from kills.
