Suspicion, ancestry, a failed die or missing documentation alone does not establish knowledge. Assessment, collection and custody require actual authorized actors; an unpaid amount remains an obligation, not automatic borrowing or remote confiscation. Cutting/reminting takes the provider's actual work and links consumed/replaced coin identities to real metal/output quantities without duplication. Unlawful trade still needs real contacts, agreed terms, actual cargo movement, any real concealment/document act and actual payment. Resolve only stages that exist as separate uncertainties. A deal does not create forged authority, a new skill or a free Scribing recipe. Underways Heat is 0–6 for the actual operation/institution pursuit history. A triggering act adds its highest applicable category once: petty illicit 1, restricted 2, strategic theft/smuggling 3, trafficking/forbidden 4. At each completed 24-hour Haven interval with an active operation, roll once; d6 at or below Heat triggers the declared enforcement complication. Heat 0 has none. Faction reporting does not add a second roll. An actual accepted bribe of 10% of the agreed lot value reduces Heat by 1, or 25% by 2, spending the payment once. An active operation's Heat cannot fall below 1; no bribe is paid at 0. Refusal or unsuccessful negotiation grants no reduction. Renaming/repacking an operation does not reset evidence, Heat or unresolved legal consequences. Enforcement requires actual actors, authority and means, not remote automatic seizure. People remain actors with factual and asserted legal status recorded separately: Free, Contracted, Debt-Bound, Penal, Enslaved, Rescued/Liberated or Disputed. A label creates no ownership, restraint or immunity. Use actual body weight, equipment and reviewed casualty Load: Tiny 1.5, Small 3, Medium 6, Large 12; larger unsupported bodies require their profile. Petrification multiplies body pounds by 10, not casualty Load. All melded and external passenger equipment burdens an outside carrier. Voluntary passengers use their actual seats/custody facts, not captive ownership. Ordinary lawful wages are 1 gp/day unskilled, 3 gp skilled or 10 gp specialist; dangerous expedition work doubles them unless the named service or real contract supplies its own rate. Do not charge both. A wage day buys at most two eight-hour work Watches and a protected Rest opportunity. Extra risky/emergency duty requires actual agreement and its costs/Rest Debt. A lawful debt bond records principal, credited wages and agreed simple interest no greater than 10% per literal Opening; no hidden compounding or automatic debt. Coercion, kidnapping, fraud or unlawful confinement cannot demand an invented buyout. An actual trafficking investigation uses an Evidence Clock 0–4. A concrete accessible lead takes one active hour and the appropriate Investigation/relevant-skill task at declared DC/stakes. Success adds 1, Critical Success 2, capped at 4; repeated evidence adds nothing. At 4, seek a real authorized warrant/hearing or plan a genuine rescue/raid. The clock does not conjure police, prove a false report or resolve combat. Guards, restraints and escape routes are actual scene facts. Consent-based adult services remain distinct from trafficking, with the table's boundaries controlling. ### FL-26 — Advancement and the next descent Choose milestone or optional XP advancement before awards. Do not grant both for the same achievement. The milestone default grants an earned stated level when its actual objective is confirmed, not simply after a Watch, appraisal or return. Follow the real class, ASI, Arch and Hero schedule and pending acquisition constraints. A higher maximum does not heal or refill a pool; retain spent resources and grant only the actually earned new unspent Hit Die. For optional XP, freeze each eligible recipient's actual gap to their next level at the beginning of the distinct award scene: | Achievement | Percentage of that frozen gap | |---|---:| | Routine | 5% | | Standard | 10% | | Hard | 15% | | Severe | 25% | | Guardian victory | 40% | | Actual profitable extraction meeting its declared threshold | 10% | | First qualifying route/text/faction discovery | 5–15%, chosen before resolution | Sum that scene's eligible predeclared percentages, cap at 60% of the frozen gap, then round the scene award once to the nearest 10 XP, halves upward. If rounding exceeds the exact 60% ceiling, limit the award to floor(0.60 × gap ÷ 10) × 10. Do not recalculate earlier percentages against a larger new gap after a mid-scene level. At a level cap or without a supplied next threshold, invent no next gap or XP award. All materially contributing members can qualify, including real reconnaissance, research, transport and support contributions away from the fight. Roster presence, unrelated waiting, repeated reports or reused evidence are not automatic contributions. Name the actual contribution, unique achievement and eligible recipient. Notifications, sale, claim or auction records of the same achievement do not award it again. Crafting-domain XP stays its own ledger. A valuable failed objective can have a predeclared reward; do not invent one after failure. Close the episode at its actual time with outcomes and the declared success metric, each member's location, routes/camps, Pressure, pursuit/Heat, provisions and containers, HP/Wounds/injuries/Strain/Rest Debt/resources, companions/devices/corpses, cargo title/custody and terminal harvest/salvage claims. Include quotes, actual payments, liabilities, insurance, attributable standing/renown, pending faction actions and earned advancement. Then accept the next charter prospectively, with real access, budget, reserves and abort conditions. A new descent does not erase unresolved disputes, replenish stock, reset clocks or replay an old claim. It can proceed only when its actual conditions allow it. ## 4. Social scenes and faction work ### SO-01 — Ask for a concrete outcome State what your character wants and how they try to obtain it. You can describe the approach in ordinary words; you do not need to perform a voice, accent or persuasive speech. Before a consequential check, establish this scene frame: | Field | What to establish | |---|---| | Want | The specific change each side wants before the scene ends | | Leverage | The offer, evidence, threat or withholding each side can actually use | | Limit | What the decision-maker cannot or will not concede under current conditions | | Clock | The real deadline and time needed for this exchange | | Witness | Who can perceive the exchange or later receive a report | Identify the people involved, the resource or information requested, its owner/controller, and who can authorize the concession. A person may possess a key without permission to sell the building. A clerk may permit supervised viewing without permission to give away the record. The Director states the obtainable success and its terms, failure, any optional costly alternative, any available extra on Critical Success, and any extra consequence on Critical Failure. Agree the approach, ability/skill, resolution method, difficulty, duration and costs before committing the work and rolling. The Director can preserve secrets while explaining an observable obstacle or that this request cannot currently succeed. A promised ordinary Success cannot secretly require Critical Success or acquire a new price after the die. If willingness, authority and prerequisites already settle a routine request, record the agreement and carry it out without a check. If the requested outcome is impossible or presently unavailable, no check can create it. You may seek a different feasible outcome. Roll when a meaningful, possible uncertainty remains. Close the approach when its agreement, refusal or interruption is recorded. Later performance can still be pending. A new request follows the changed-circumstances rules below. ### SO-02 — Resolve the declared uncertainty Choose the procedure before seeing any dice. A social concession or bounded inference normally uses a task against a fixed DC. Two actors making genuinely opposed attempts can use opposed totals. An explicit feature using a saving throw or passive Insight keeps its own procedure. These are new ordinary references where no more specific source supplies the DC: | DC | Negotiable concession | |---:|---| | 10 | Plausible, modest and within the person's authority | | 13 | The person has a substantial reservation | | 16 | Difficult, but genuinely negotiable | | 19 | Exceptional leverage for an actually possible outcome | Do not add a general route-tier or standing modifier to these DCs. Use only adjustments an applicable rule actually grants. For a fixed task, compare the total with the DC: at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC−10 is Critical Failure; the remaining totals below DC are Failure. Then a natural 20 improves one degree and a natural 1 worsens one, bounded at the ends. An impossible action does not acquire a roll or a fabricated failure margin. | Final degree | Result | |---|---| | Critical Success | The promised success on its stated terms, plus only the declared available extra | | Success | The promised success on its stated terms | | Failure | The declared refusal/failure; a costly alternative exists only if offered beforehand and feasible | | Critical Failure | That failure plus only the declared actual extra consequence; a costly alternative exists only if expressly offered for this branch | An optional costly agreement is separate from the failed check. Accept its stated terms if willing and able, or decline and keep the unspent payment along with the refusal. Accepting needs no new roll merely to enact a feasible offer. Its performance still takes time, and the original roll remains failed. No outcome degree automatically supplies obedience, truth, standing, consent or resources. For opposed checks, compare the two declared final totals: higher wins; a tie leaves the existing situation unchanged. Task degree shifts for natural 1/20 do not apply, and there is no general opposed critical reward. Ordinary saves remain binary under Core. Apply an operative source's reroll only in its exact window and with its exact replacement rule. ### SO-03 — Choose a skill for the approach | Skill | What the approach can resolve | |---|---| | CHA (Persuasion) | A genuinely negotiable decision on stated terms | | CHA (Deception) | Belief in a particular communicated claim | | CHA (Intimidation) | A decision influenced by a credible perceived risk | | CHA (Performance) | The declared audience response to an actual performance | | CHA (Reputation) | An appeal to credentials or standing actually known or credibly demonstrated to the recipient | | WIS (Insight) | A supported inference about observed motive, hesitation or leverage | | INT (Investigation), History or an appropriate tool/skill | Its actual evidence or knowledge task, such as examining a document | Add one applicable proficiency contribution, or expertise replacing it where granted. Several persuasive proficiencies do not add several bonuses. Neither a numeric trade level nor the saved standing score adds another bonus unless a specific operative rule says so. Deception can change a belief without changing history. Insight cannot read an inaccessible document, detect every lie, read minds or force a player to believe a diagnosis. A sound answer can be that the observed evidence cannot distinguish two motives. Translation establishes received meaning, not truth. A particular lie confronted by active scrutiny can use CHA (Deception) opposed by WIS (Insight). A bounded inference without an active opponent normally uses a fixed DC. Physical forgery examination uses its declared Investigation/tool procedure. A credible threat does not automatically require a saving throw or impose Frightened. A genuine competing social strategy can be an opposed attempt when declared that way beforehand. Useful true information may settle a routine request without rolling. A successful Performance grants its stated audience response, not a license, access to property or magical crowd control. A Reputation appeal must have evidence the recipient can actually receive. The result does not automatically change permanent standing. ### SO-04 — Use standing as a relationship This chapter uses the new ordinary standing scale taught in the Haven module: | Score | Band | |---:|---| | −3 or −2 | Hated | | −1 | Disliked | | 0 | Neutral | | +1 | Liked | | +2 or +3 | Honored | Standing can influence whether an institution will consider a request and what terms are plausible. It does not itself create permission, credit, an appointment, available stock or authority. It adds no automatic bonus, penalty, advantage or disadvantage to a social check under this procedure. CHA (Reputation) remains a separate skill: add its one eligible proficiency/expertise contribution to an appropriate appeal. A known score of +2 does not add another +2. Specific acquired item, class and background modifiers retain their actual conditions and stacking rules. Reviewed equipment sale fractions still use the buyer's known relationship where that particular schedule applies; they are not a universal price modifier. When bringing forward an older character, preserve the original score and its version. A companion record marked +2 and an older Loop record marked +2 did not use the same labels. Unknown versions need interpretation before use; absence is not a recorded neutral score. Keep genuinely earned access, titles and obligations even when deriving a new display. ### SO-05 — Keep alignment-dependent questions separate Ordinary social checks in this candidate receive no automatic alignment-derived advantage or disadvantage. Shared goals, stated values, promises and trustworthy conduct can provide genuine leverage in the scene; they do not establish a cosmic classification or add a numerical modifier. An acquired oath or class feature still follows its exact stated restrictions. If a particular use depends on a deep meaning not yet defined, record that specific unresolved requirement. It does not prevent ordinary conversation, trade, travel or a standing record. The older alignment-modifier wording is preserved for the later cosmology review. This chapter does not establish its compatibility chart or activate that general modifier. ### SO-06 — Keep one clock and a working channel Everyone participates on the same fictional clock. A ten-minute negotiation involving four people normally advances ten minutes, provided their actual exchanges fit that time. A person's contribution can occupy that interval without adding another ten minutes to the world. Declare these new ordinary time references before work: | Exchange | Actual time | |---|---| | Short request and answer | 1 minute | | Negotiated concession or evidence presentation | 10 minutes | | Formal complex negotiation/hearing | Its scheduled time; an ordinary disputed Haven hearing is 2 hours | Simple routine consent can be immediate within real brief communication. These references do not replace a printed Action, casting time, five-exchange limit or other specific procedure. Add time for actual extra exchanges or delays, not for how quickly a player speaks at the table. In initiative, each creature has at most six seconds of aggregate free ordinary speech/signs per numbered round. Replies, warnings and extra turns share it. Each additional six-second segment requires an available Action on a legal turn or an actual off-turn permission. Communication does not create an interruption, Reaction or additional Action. Use the fulfilled language rules for ten-minute rehearsal of up to six simple cues and each cue's actual hands, sight and distance. An interpreter first receives a comprehensible message, then conveys it through a channel the next person can receive. A three-second warning followed by a three-second rendition arrives at the second listener at six seconds. A ten-minute original speech plus its rendition needs time for both; relays do not happen instantly. Late information cannot backdate a decision, modifier, consent or saving-throw requirement. An interpreter does not supply a caster's verbal component, new fluency, a mental link, the meaning of an unknown proper name or proof the message is true. Use each participant's actual language, mode and script knowledge. A closed soundproof compartment cannot receive an oral instruction through a high check. Deafened does not itself prevent speaking or verbal components. Silenced prevents ordinary deliberate speech and actual verbal components, Chants and command words, while separately legal signs, thoughts or mental effects retain their own rules. An effect ending does not remove another overlapping prohibition. Form-specific limits and exact Oracle/Paladin exceptions remain in force. Player explanations and accessibility accommodations cost no fictional Action and produce no fictional speech or component. ### SO-07 — Help with the work; retry when something changes In initiative, Help uses its actual Action and expires at the helper's next regular start. The contribution must be possible with the helper's real position, channel, tools and information. Social play does not extend the expiry to a convenient later check. The attack-assistance branch still requires a foe within 5 feet and benefits the helped ally's first attack before that deadline. Outside initiative, this new procedure grants advantage on one check when a helper participates usefully throughout the relevant work interval through its resolution. The helper needs the actual language, access, knowledge or tools their contribution requires. There is no new universal proficiency requirement where ordinary Help has none. Mere presence, payment or ownership of a better tool is not Help. A helper's time is occupied. They cannot also guard a different room, rest, travel elsewhere or fully help a simultaneous separate negotiation. If an exact long task defines its own trained assistants and numeric cap, use that procedure without adding this general Help benefit. Multiple sources of advantage do not stack; any advantage and any disadvantage cancel to a normal roll under Core. Resolve one committed approach to the same uncertainty once. Rotating speakers, repeating the sentence or renaming the scene does not grant more attempts. A new offer, authentic new evidence, an audience with different real authority, a changed deadline or a meaningfully different method can create a new uncertainty. Identify that change and declare the new stakes, time and costs before rolling. Earlier refusal, spent time, payments, consumed evidence and other consequences remain. A source-granted reroll follows its exact cost, timing and new-result rule; it is not permission for unlimited retries. ### SO-08 — Apply the exact magical effect Charmed is a relationship to an identified charmer. It prevents choices the affected creature knows would willingly harm that charmer and gives that charmer advantage on social ability checks against it. It does not compel affection, obedience, belief, allegiance, surrender, protection, self-harm, consent, ownership or truthful speech. Unexpected collateral harm is not retroactively a willing violation. Frightened gives disadvantage on checks and attacks while the creature can see its fear source. Its restriction against willingly moving closer to that source continues while the condition lasts, even when the visibility-based disadvantage no longer applies. Forced movement is not willing approach. Successful ordinary Intimidation grants only its declared concession and does not automatically apply this condition. Use the complete procedure of an effect the character has legitimately acquired and can currently use. Pay its activation and resources, check range and target eligibility, apply its actual save, resistance/immunity, concentration, duration, awareness and ending rules. A social check cannot replace a spell save or recreate a resisted payload. An immunity to charm or a named control effect does not by itself prevent ordinary persuasion. No general language requirement is added where an effect has none; printed hearing, sight and component requirements still apply. A feature that offers refusal or backlash keeps that choice. A title or a familiar spell name does not grant an unavailable effect or merge ordinary, class, innate and recipe versions. Knowledge features reveal only information supported by their exact source and subject. Unknown remains possible. They do not establish ownership, invent a buyer or route, supply an absent cure or resolve deferred cosmology. ### SO-09 — Record agreements and respect table choices Record an agreement's actual parties and authority, property or service, deliverable, consideration, time, communication, witnesses and remedies. A clerk's promise of supervised access is not a transfer of the employer's ledger. A guard's key does not authorize selling the absent owner's property. Later breach is a new event; it does not change the earlier die result. The Session Zero agreement governs player consent and table boundaries. A skill check cannot assign a player's belief, require acting, override agreed PvP limits or grant their willingness to an effect that requires it. A player can pause, skip or request an accessible way to participate without explaining personal circumstances or receiving a character penalty. Apply any explicit magical control procedure with its own actual agency and refusal limits. Accepting a costly alternative requires the real payer's choice and funds. Failure alone does not deduct the payment. An unavailable object, absent person or forged receipt cannot provide missing performance. Establish each relevant permission when that operation needs it. A later agreement cannot retroactively supply a missing action prerequisite or turn counterfeit provenance into genuine evidence. ### SO-10 — Let consequences reach the people who react Standing changes follow significant attributable acts and a real way for the institution to learn about them. Record what happened, who acted, witnesses or documents, what each recipient actually learned, and when. A privately rescued person's relationship may change before any institution hears the story. Public means exposed or documented to a relevant audience; it does not mean every faction instantly knows. One deed reported five times remains one underlying cause for that institution. Different institutions can react differently when their interests and information actually differ. Separate established facts from reports and beliefs. An institution can act on a lie it believes; that belief does not rewrite the historical event. A later correction creates a new evidence/response record, not silent erasure or an automatic equal-and-opposite score change. For ordinary standing, start from the subject's score at the opening of that institution/scene record. Sum the signed proposed changes from distinct eligible events, limit that sum to −2 through +2, then apply the −3 through +3 scale. Keep proposed change, applied change and any overflow. Overflow is historical information, not future credit. Recompute from the scene opening as additional events arrive; do not saturate each event separately and lose an offsetting change. A successful social check does not automatically award standing, renown or a license. A genuinely performed, attributable public outcome can support the declared event. Existing titles, access, obligations and privileges remain separate records with their own terms. Delayed notice cannot backdate permission to an earlier purchase. ### SO-11 — Faction activity takes real work Other groups act on the campaign clock using the people, resources and information they actually possess. Their work can continue while your expedition is away. After a genuine expedition return, the Director reviews up to three watched factions and one eligible action for each. A return closes a real episode with an objective and outcome, including abandonment or extraction. Repeatedly crossing the boundary during the same return does not create more activity. A split party's arrivals stay linked to their actual episode. The new regular review also occurs at each completed campaign 24-hour boundary. A return at exactly the same time and that scheduled review form one checkpoint. A checkpoint records and reports work; it does not itself advance the world by 24 hours or give free labor, goods, recruits or success. | Action | Actual ordinary work when no more specific procedure applies | |---|---| | Recruit | 8 active staff hours seeking/interviewing one available candidate | | Denounce | 1 active hour preparing/delivering one attributable statement to an actual audience | | Buy | 1 active hour arranging/executing an available bill with real goods, funds and authority | | Raid | Actual preparation, route, encounter and resolution | | Research | The particular research process; a generic original-evidence question requires 8 active hours and its declared knowledge task | | Fortify | Actual construction under the camp procedure | | Bargain | 1 active hour of concrete negotiation | | Conceal | 8 active hours working on finite evidence, an asset or a route | | Wait | The actual interval and status, with no automatic money, healing or knowledge | Specific procedures keep their actual duration and costs, even when shorter. Do not add a second free faction outcome to them. An ongoing project keeps its identity and accumulated work. A return cannot replace it with an instantly completed action. When real work finishes between checkpoints, its consequences occur then. A later report acknowledges them once. People who witness the result can react immediately without waiting for the administrative review. News still needs a real messenger, rumor, changed offer, guard presence or other observable event to reach you. ### SO-12 — Rival objectives leave a history Rival groups have bounded goals, strengths, weaknesses and information. They travel real routes, need support, and can offer useful cooperation as well as opposition. Their successes can change the situation without erasing your expedition's choices. The Director tracks four kinds of objective clock: | Clock | Length fixed when opened | Qualifying progress | |---|---:|---| | Depth | 4–8 | Actual travel or support that materially advances its named route objective | | Claim | 4 | Genuinely obtained relevant proof, witnesses or legal support | | Grudge | 4 | Attributable humiliation, loss, betrayal or public accusation actually learned by the rival | | Collapse | 4–6 | Actual casualty, debt, internal conflict or exposure materially advancing the named crisis | One distinct qualifying event advances that clock by one segment. Several labels for the same deed or repeated reports do not add segments. A knowledge-dependent trigger qualifies when the rival first credibly receives it, not when an unknown event happens elsewhere. One event can affect different clocks only through independently real consequences. The Director declares the finite completion consequence and its prerequisites when opening the clock. Reaching its threshold resolves it once only when those prerequisites exist. Otherwise it remains at its threshold with the specific missing requirement recorded. A clock does not teleport travelers, authenticate a false witness, create title or grant an extra attack. An objective already actually completed needs no meaningless extra ticks. A resolved objective keeps its event history; a new clock needs a distinct objective or crisis. A genuine reversal is another recorded event, not erasure or an automatic refund. Players learn only the rival identity, events and consequences their characters can actually know. ## 5. Mounts, vehicles and transport ### TR-01 — Choose an actual mount Use the complete [transport catalogue](TRANSPORT_CATALOGUE_CANDIDATE.md) for Camel, Donkey or mule, Elephant, Draft horse, Riding horse, War horse, Mastiff, Pony and Warhound. Each is a separate profile. “Donkey or mule” means one chosen individual. The printed price, walking Speed and carrying pounds are retained. A carrying rating does not determine Strength or make a template a record of the particular animal being sold. Saves use its ability modifier without an added save proficiency unless an actual source grants it. Ordinary senses do not grant darkvision or automatic detection. These profiles supply no class levels, RP, spellcasting, special immunity or class features. An independent animal's listed attack costs its Action and makes one attack using that profile's bonus, reach and damage. Core attack criticals apply. It has no automatic charge damage, knockdown or Multiattack, and the rider receives no extra attack. A controlled ridden mount instead uses the restricted Action choices below. Large mounts occupy a 10-foot square, Medium mounts a 5-foot square, and the new Huge Elephant a 15-foot square. A saddle admits one physically compatible rider at least one size smaller. A Medium character cannot ride a Medium Pony merely because their weight is low. Count the rider, all equipment, tack, containers and contents against both the mount's pounds and Load limits. Its separate harness draw rating is not extra back capacity. A positive carried burden at or above half either profile limit applies the one Burdened penalty: Speed −10 feet and disadvantage to climbing, swimming or moving silently. Do not apply it twice because both measures qualify. Routine carriage must fit both full limits and the actual body/seat geometry. An actual Ranger Beast bond instead follows its own HP-only, immediate-death lifecycle. No repair, stable fee, new template or replacement purchase revives a dead individual. ### TR-02 — Control and training A physically compatible, trained and willing mount can be controlled. An intelligent or untrained independent mount keeps its own agency. Ownership, restraint and payment do not establish willingness or training. A conscious, nonincapacitated seated rider can direct intended movement and choose the controlled mount's one allowed Action: **Dash, Disengage or Dodge**. Use an actual trained audible or tactile channel. An audible cue shares the language rules' speech allowance. Reins require an available hand; a trained seat/leg cue works only if that individual knows it and the current seat permits it. Ordinary riding direction adds no separate Bonus Action. It does not issue a class companion command, authorize an attack or transfer rider bonuses to the animal. A controlled mount with its own regular turn counts toward the controller's existing limit of two commanded independent-turn combat-capable subordinates. The controller's own character is separate. A source-bound companion with only an attached phase retains its own command and offensive budgets; calling it a mount does not give it a full turn. Additional pack animals can be led outside combat through real handling, but do not give a third controlled combat turn. There is no automatic animal swarm. An independent NPC acting as a party character counts toward the twelve-character roster. A merely ridden animal does not occupy a member seat, although its actions, cargo, provisions and history still matter. Independent animals are directed by their real agency, not treated as free player attack orders. Recheck control when the mount acts. If the rider is no longer seated or able to cue it, the channel fails, or the mount is unable or unwilling, an unexecuted riding cue cannot compel it. If able, it defensively Dodges and stays still or moves only to an immediately safer available space, chosen through its actual agency. Its existing turn and spent budgets do not reset. An executed cue is not undone. A legitimate trained noncombat lead/follow cue can continue only while its actual conditions and handler remain available. **New ordinary training course.** A genuinely tame, willing animal can learn one named riding or harness function through 40 active hours, at most four credited training hours per animal per day. The instructor needs Animal Handling proficiency, a suitable safe space, fitting tack and a usable conditioning method. Credit complete 15-minute phases. An interruption loses unfinished prospective phase credit; actual time, feed and fees remain spent. The full-course tuition reference is 5 gp, unless an actual voluntary or paid agreement differs. Completion requires the real course and demonstrated safe routine behavior. It grants only the practiced function, without an obedience spell, rider proficiency or Ranger bond. A documented already-trained animal needs no repeat course. Wildness or unwillingness cannot be cured by depositing hours. A war-named purchase includes combat habituation only if its actual contract and behavior establish it. Feed, water, tack and stabling are separate unless genuinely included. ### TR-03 — One complete mount turn At initiative registration, a controlled mount shares its rider's initiative value and takes one complete regular turn immediately **after** the rider's complete regular turn. Their movement and Actions do not interleave. You cannot move the mount twenty feet, insert a free rider attack segment, then finish the mount's movement. You may Ready a permitted Action through the normal procedure, paying your Action and later Reaction, with its actual trigger, components and duration. This creates no free attack. An independent mount keeps its own initiative and choices. The mount has its own regular-start/end markers, movement, normal Action and applicable Reaction budget. Its controlled Actions remain Dash, Disengage and Dodge. Control grants no offensive Reaction or opportunity attack; a specific defensive Reaction works only if actually available. It makes its own death saves when its lifecycle requires them. A rider's extra turn does not create another mount turn, start, recharge or condition tick. Each physical actor receives at most one scheduled regular turn per numbered round. Mounting, dismounting or changing controllers retains its spent budgets and original allocated slot for that round. A new valid controlled relation takes its new rider-linked position beginning next round. This round, use the existing unspent slot if any; never replay a taken one. A mount entering mid-round uses a legal not-yet-passed insertion under the combat-entry rules, or starts next round. It does not replay the new rider's earlier slot. Changing to independent behavior also grants no second turn. Separate rider and mount effects still expire at their own stated markers even when initiative values match. ### TR-04 — Mounting, dismounting and losing the seat An ordinary mount or voluntary dismount costs half your current walking Speed, rounded down in feet, from your remaining regular movement. A positive Speed whose half is below one instead costs one foot. Speed 0 does not permit it. You may perform at most one mount **or** dismount operation per regular turn; an extra turn supplies no additional operation through this rule. The cost is movement, not a Bonus Action or free object interaction. Start within five feet of the accessible seat at a reachable height, with a stable approach, one usable supporting hand and a physically fitting destination. A high Elephant saddle needs actual steps, help or a legal route to reach it; an exotic saddle does not lift you. If Prone, first stand using the real cost or use another valid assisted procedure. Mounting does not remove Prone. To dismount, choose a visible, free adjacent space within five feet of the relevant body boundary at a reachable level. A wall, another creature, an inadequate gap or an unpaid fall is not a legal destination. Insufficient remaining movement or an inaccessible seat prevents the ordinary operation. A specific acquired feature overrides only its actual clause. The animal's remaining movement and Actions stay unchanged. When one resolved source event moves a seated rider's mount against its will **or** knocks it Prone, the rider makes one DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. If that same event does both, make one save. Distinct events can each trigger a save. This is a binary Core save with no generic natural 1/20 degree shifts. On failure, leave the seat and land Prone in the first legal adjacent space from your recorded dismount preference, or the Director's neutral accessible ordering. Resolve actual height and falling under the falling rules; unseating adds no fixed damage by itself. On success, retain the seat only if support remains physically possible. A Prone mount does not automatically make its successful rider Prone, but its awkward body and blocked movement still matter. A rider independently made Prone gains that condition without another seat save. Voluntary ordinary travel alone causes no save. If an exact effect ejects you regardless of a save, use that effect and the actual landing. Impossible support or landing resolves through the real fall/entrapment situation, never placement inside a wall. ### TR-05 — Position, areas and opportunity attacks Record the rider's actual saddle point or fitting five-foot subspace on the mount before movement. Attacks, reach, line of effect and area exposure use that position, not every edge of an Elephant's footprint. Moving to another accessible seat position takes your own real movement, path and support. Rider and mount remain two creatures with separate AC, HP, conditions and resources. Actual barriers and body geometry can supply cover under the normal rules. When the mount's own voluntary movement provokes a legal opportunity attack, the reactor may choose the mount **or** rider. The rider's own Disengage protects the rider's own voluntary movement; it does not give the mount Disengage. Your own movement around the seat or while dismounting uses your own opportunity-attack rules. Forced displacement or teleportation does not provoke a generic movement opportunity attack, although an actual seat-save trigger or other specific effect may apply. An attack against the mount does not automatically damage or unseat its rider; its actual consequence must trigger that result. Vehicle carriage does not use this living-mount exception. Passive displacement of vehicle occupants gives no generic opportunity attack without a specific source. Moving pullers can provoke for themselves, without granting an attack through a wall against a distant passenger. ### TR-06 — Movement belongs to the actor who performs it Riding changes your position, but it does not automatically spend your movement, perform your leap, count as your flight or charge, deal your weapon damage or activate a class feature. Mounts, vehicles and transport ### TR-01 — Choose an actual mount Keep the individual's original body history through purchase, hire, boarding, rescue, bond and sale. A healthy profile does not prove that a merchant's specimen is healthy, willing, trained or available. Significance cannot be changed after a fatal outcome. The new threat reference level is solely for the expedition encounter-budget comparison. It is neither CR nor class level. An effect requiring a source CR still needs that actual missing predicate. Do not substitute threat reference, purchase value or carrying rating for a bond prerequisite or harvest table. The catalogue's Load and draw limits are separately authored. They do not follow an inferred Strength formula and cannot be increased by recalculating one. Apply later actual source exceptions only where they govern this same individual. ### TR-02 — Control and training Record the controlling relation, the trained function and cue, seated rider, available hand/channel, animal willingness, actor-cap usage and actual turn. Ordinary riding cues are rechecked at execution; this explicitly differs from a protected already-issued attached companion command that may survive owner incapacity. Do not import TI04 device binding, a shared companion Bonus Action or an attack allowance into ordinary riding. Carriage and ship control have the separately paid Actions below. Unattended lead/follow is not a programmable tactical routine or unlimited work. Training is an actual bounded course. Its maximum four hours/day applies to that animal, not a new cap per instructor or per course name. Forty hours means at least ten such training days. Safe completion grants no immunity to later fear, fatigue, pain, anatomy restrictions or changed conditions. ### TR-03 — One complete mount turn Record actor ID, numbered round, regular-turn ID, original slot, prospective next-round slot, control history, and movement/Action/Reaction spent. Keep condition and death-save ordering attached to the actual creature. Ordinary ridden turns are whole turns. The coordinated puller reservation for a drawn vehicle below is a specific exception for one linked vehicle movement, not permission to split every mount's turn. Travel and initiative transitions preserve real movement/work and do not duplicate ticks or rewards. ### TR-04 — Mounting, dismounting and losing the seat Predeclare the actual saddle point, approach and preferred dismount ordering where relevant. Record the triggering source event so one forced-and-Prone result does not create two saves. Do not infer another trigger from a renamed template or the rider's own Prone condition. Success is not immunity to falling when no supporting body remains. Keep actual seat compatibility and the control predicates separate from the save. Resolve height, falling, collision and support through their own real sources instead of inserting an automatic unseat-damage packet. ### TR-05 — Position, areas and opportunity attacks Keep the mount footprint, rider seat, actual movement path and each target's defenses. At a provoking edge, validate the chosen target before spending/rolling the reaction. Actual legal defensive reactions belong to the chosen target; no mount-and-rider pooled defense is created. The same movement cannot provoke twice merely because both rider and mount moved. Turning travel into initiative is not a movement event. A positional aura reads actual body locations even when carriage does not qualify for a self-powered movement benefit. ### TR-06 — Movement belongs to the actor who performs it Preserve the literal Dragoon protected interface and complete engine alongside this new interpretation; the old sentence did not explicitly say self-propelled. The fifteen-foot Momentum trigger and twenty-foot casting interaction are separate gates. A legal dismount, self-powered move/leap and personal attack can satisfy the actual engine, without counting the same path twice. Keep both complete pending feat records, their original flags and current full-review-pending status. Old needsReview:false is not proof of current review. No broad text match across 1,223 class cards establishes movement eligibility. Exact position, actor, turn, movement budget and activation predicates are required. Nothing here replaces closed companion commands, recipe devices, servicing, recycling, recharge or source-specific casting procedures. ### TR-07 — Tack, food, water and boarding All fourteen original tack/drawn-vehicle/service rows retain their full source records, including comma placeholders, null numerical weights and source status. New physical quantities are separate fields. A service is not a half-pound object; unknown weight is not zero. Record actual fitting, workers, hands, anatomy, item HP, stock, nutrition and custody. A caretaker cannot supervise incompatible remote pens at the same time. The ten-minute calm care allowance is not emergency veterinary treatment. Barding cost, mass, HP and worn AC use distinct rules. Apply the actual sized armor reference once for repair, not the animal's purchase value or HP. Fitted tack can be repaired from its actual primary body and compatible subordinate parts; neither repair nor a saddle creates a missing animal. ### TR-08 — Drawn vehicles and the two sleds Record the coordinated movement reservation as one exceptional vehicle event, not ordinary interleaved riding turns. Each puller needs a legal existing movement budget and actual control; the vehicle does not create free offensive caravan actors. One Action or movement contribution cannot pay a different task too. Cart, Wagon, Carriage, Chariot and Player Sled retain their complete catalogue dimensions, seats, primary structures and terrain. Do not equate a frame's HP with payload or use an invented five-times-Strength towing formula. An indivisible blocked bend remains a real route problem. A disabled frame strands its actual cargo until a feasible unload, transfer, support or tow occurs. HP 0 alone does not destroy occupants, contents or source history. Collision, dislodgement and falling are separate actual events with their declared consequences. ### TR-09 — Watercraft need working crews The full profiles preserve each exact active-mode Speed, mph, minimum depth, geometry, occupant count and original-body repair requirements. New operating values do not fill in or overwrite the old source blanks. “Warship” grants no ballista or separate combat-stat package. Track all paid crew contributions, current availability, the single numbered-round drive event and the actual resulting path. Passive passenger displacement is not personal movement expenditure, Dragoon Momentum or the mounted opportunity-attack exception. Passengers may do compatible tasks only when the actual environment permits; a moving ship is not automatically a full workshop or safe rest site. No vessel quote supplies a conveniently present rescue boat or crew. Plan escape from actual positions, remaining time, usable lines, boats, bodies and Actions. Real support can preserve a disabled wreck for repair; its contents and history remain real even if submerged. ### TR-10 — Porters, bearers and hired pack animals Keep service scope separate from anatomy and ownership. A contracted six Load may fit a mule's body but not its actual current burden or route. The rate purchases an agreed service interval, not feed or unlimited extra work unless the offer really includes it. Apply the service-specific price before the one accepted danger multiplier. Do not add the generic 1/3/10 gp wage schedule to the named porter/bearer rate or double once per danger adjective. Maintain actual paid/owed status without automatic borrowing. Calm loading uses the transfer schedule below. Dangerous travel uses the real route/encounter procedure, not another service roll that charges the same consequence twice. Actual workers' consent, refusal and information remain distinct from inert inventory. ### TR-11 — The bound hauler and specialist services The hauler is bound to the separate core.transport.hauler profile. The 500 gp quote and 20/30 Load references are historical; its mass, body, oil, maintenance, control and repair are explicitly new additions. Do not replace these with a class machine's rules because both are called a hauler. Track exact accumulated moving time, fuel fractions, refill/consumption events, service-due state and actual completed work. A partial service is not completed service, and one work interval cannot also restore HP or recharge another device. A damaged required mechanism must be made serviceable through its real repair before routine service can qualify. Caravan availability, a real slot and the actual specialist teleport are world inputs. Do not invent infinite capacity, a current spell, post-Opening access, planar permission or spatial-container capacity from a price. Preserve Living/Changed, Pact and deep-setting labels literally for the later review. ### TR-12 — People, stretchers and cargo transfers Keep distinct body, gear, containers and shares. Petrification changes only the body pounds and never turns six casualty Load into sixty. Reusing a transformed character's personal meld exemption on the outside carrier would omit real weight. The stretcher's patient admission and each carrier's total burden are independent checks. Its frame and every gear item still count. An unstable transfer can fail even when numerical limits fit; conversely no roll is needed to invent uncertainty in a genuinely safe supported lift. Preserve voluntary, unconscious, restrained and disputed-custody states separately. Unknown actual landing space or insufficient support is not repaired by a cargo tag. A dead body remains the same history-bearing body under its real lifecycle, not a fresh generic loot bundle. ### TR-13 — One route rate, with real transfers Keep route identity and fraction complete before changing the limiting rate. Record actual physical quality independently of Unknown/Sketched/Mapped/Secured mapping knowledge and Risk 1–5. Apply the 480-minute reference only once to the actual work tranche. Do not use a zero required-carrier speed as a division shortcut or silently omit that actor. Determine the real transfer, abandonment or repair first. Source-specific route/hazard rules override only their actual scope. For declared cargo loss, retain the original at-risk manifest, event, chosen eligible lots/portions and indivisibility remainder. Do not stack the Core illustration with a Loop consequence unless they are genuinely independent declared effects. Living/Changed and Pact Interdiction remain literal specialist/deep-setting receipts, without invented geography, causes or permissions. ### TR-14 — Recover living creatures; repair actual structures Distinguish living treatment, mundane structural repair, recipe-magical restoration, the new hauler bridge and one-time emergency shoring. Each uses its real eligibility and source. A payment is not evidence that a missing body, material, worker or worksite exists. For a damaged vessel, record damage-event ID, HP-0 time, original deadline, shoring eligibility, workers, uninterrupted interval, supplies, result, any sixty-minute hold deadline, actual support and evacuation. The hull does not regain movement from successful shoring. A failed or interrupted attempt cannot backdate completion beyond the old deadline. Track rescued actors and goods individually, with actual custody, remaining conditions and source history. Keep family admission, overload, control-loss, interrupted-movement, damage/HP-0, repair/rescue and provenance examples as authored expectations. They do not claim that live transport software or human balance has been tested. ### Worked chapter cases #### TRX-01 **Situation:** A willing animal completes the40-hour ordinary training course at its maximum4 credited hours/day. **Expected result:** At least10 training days are required; two instructors cannot create an8-hour animal training day. #### TRX-02 **Situation:** A rider acts, then its mount begins its whole turn and moves into a new reach. **Expected result:** The rider has no inserted free turn segment. operational.targets: Self; choose one exact known canonical factionId.
operational.resolution: No roll. Privately learn one actual current major institutional objective of the chosen faction. No physical representative, positive reputation, membership, Faction Seal permission, geographic distance or planar anchor is required.
operational.effect: A qualifying objective is a concrete established goal pursued or prioritized by the institution or its recognized governing authority, such as securing a trade route, recovering a stolen archive or removing a named governor from office. A member’s private wish, reputation inference or the Director’s preferred plot is not an institutional objective. If several objectives are genuinely coequal, the Director records one stable priority selection while that institutional state remains materially unchanged. Equivalent repeat casts across casters/rephrasing do not rotate through hidden coequal goals. Report No Current Major Objective only for genuine established absence; undefined or specifically protected institutional information reports Indeterminate. Independently readable portions of a meaningful goal may be stated while protected details remain Indeterminate, without identifying which ward or hidden record caused the limit.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Protection of one leader’s personal information does not erase an independently established institutional objective, and a protected private plan does not become institutional merely to evade protection. A subfaction must have its own actual canonical identity to be selected separately; invented subdivisions are not extra inquiries. The spell does not directly reveal an operational plan, member list, exact locations, timetable, secret agents, resources or every subordinate objective.
